base.name: Complexity.sph_record_size
base.header: private lemma sph_record_size (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : ∀ n, logSpace n ≤ g n) (k n : ℕ) : recordLength k n (g n) + (g n).bits.length + g n + 1 ≤ (4 * k + 9) * g n :=

base.name: Complexity.sph_valid_machine
base.header: private lemma sph_valid_machine (M : FinTM Bool) (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : ∀ n, logSpace n ≤ g n) (c : ℕ) (G : FinTM Bool) (hG : G.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (g x.length).bits) (fun n => c * g n)) : ∃ (k : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (D : MultiTapeTM k (RecSym M.State (Fin 3)) P) (entry : P) (B : ℕ), ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t b, (D.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State (Fin 3)))) t).state = none ∧ (D.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State (Fin 3)))) t).output = [RecSym.digit b] ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(D.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State (Fin 3)))) u).workTapePos j| ≤ ((B * g x.length : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ w : List Bool, M.ComputesInTime x w (M.configBound x.length (g x.length)) → M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) (M.configBound x.length (g x.length)) ≤ g x.length → b = !(decide (w = [true]))) :=

base.name: Complexity.sph_halt_contract
base.header: private lemma sph_halt_contract {k : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} {ys : List Γ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ P) (entry : P) (d : Cfg k Γ P ys) (t B : ℕ) (ht : (M.runFrom d t).state = none) (hh : ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(M.runFrom d u).workTapePos j| ≤ (B : ℤ)) : ∃ C : Contract M entry {none} Unit ys, (∀ a, C.pre () a ↔ a = d) ∧ C.post () d = M.runFrom d t ∧ (∀ a j, C.lo () a j = -(B : ℤ) ∧ C.hi () a j = (B : ℤ)) :=

base.name: Complexity.sph_validated_machine
base.header: private lemma sph_validated_machine {k : ℕ} {Q P : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (V : MultiTapeTM k (RecSym Q (Fin 3)) P) (entry : P) (S : ℕ → ℕ) (pred : List Bool → Bool → Prop) (hV : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t b, (V.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q (Fin 3)))) t).state = none ∧ (V.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q (Fin 3)))) t).output = [RecSym.digit b] ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(V.runFrom (Cfg.init entry (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q (Fin 3)))) u).workTapePos j| ≤ (S x.length : ℤ)) ∧ pred x b) : ∃ D : FinTM (RecSym Q (Fin 3)), ∀ ys : List (RecSym Q (Fin 3)), ∃ t b, D.ComputesInTime ys [RecSym.digit b] t ∧ D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg ys) t ≤ k * (2 * S ys.length + 1) ∧ ∀ x : List Bool, ys = x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q (Fin 3)) → pred x b :=

base.name: Complexity.sph_diagonal_language
base.header: private lemma sph_diagonal_language (M : FinTM Bool) (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : SpaceConstructible g) : ∃ L : Language Bool, L ∈ SPACE g ∧ ∀ (x w : List Bool), M.ComputesInTime x w (M.configBound x.length (g x.length)) → M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) (M.configBound x.length (g x.length)) ≤ g x.length → MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x = !(decide (w = [true])) :=

base.name: Complexity.sph_linear_ne_NP_of_padding
base.header: private lemma sph_linear_ne_NP_of_padding (hH : ∀ f g : ℕ → ℕ, SpaceConstructible f → SpaceConstructible g → (∀ A : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, A * f n ≤ g n) → SPACE f ⊂ SPACE g) (hpad : ∀ L : Language Bool, L ∈ SPACE (fun n => n ^ 2 + 1) → ({y | ∃ x ∈ L, y = pairEncode x (List.replicate (1 * (x.length + 1) ^ 2) true)} : Language Bool) ∈ SPACE (fun n => n + 1)) : SPACE (fun n => n + 1) ≠ NP :=

base.header: theorem LOGSPACE_ssubset_PSPACE : LOGSPACE ⊂ PSPACE :=

base.header: theorem SPACE_linear_ne_NP : SPACE (fun n => n + 1) ≠ NP :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_full_embed
head.header: private theorem f6_full_embed {m : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) : embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (le_refl m)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c = c :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_seam
head.header: private theorem f6_seam {k : ℕ} {S₁ S₂ : Type} [DecidableEq S₁] {x : List Bool} (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry q₂ : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Bool S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Bool S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) T₂ = c₃) (hq : c₃.state = some q₂) (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂, (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) t).state ≠ some q₂) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = c₃.mapState Sum.inr ∧ (c₃.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂)).state = some (Sum.inr q₂) ∧ ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, ((seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂) :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_native_halt
head.header: private theorem f6_native_halt (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (A : MultiTapeTM (K + 3) Bool (P ⊕ Unit)), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ w : List Bool, A.runFrom (A.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (T + 2) = ⟨none, 1, fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (c.decode α).tm.tr) else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin (c.decode α).tm.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ ∧ (∀ u < T + 2, (A.runFrom (A.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ none) :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_header
head.header: private theorem f6_header (K : ℕ) (u v : List Bool) : let z := pairEncode u v let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2 let r : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3) let e : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) z := ⟨some (Sum.inr .done), ⟨ℓ + 1, by show 2 * u.length + 2 + 1 < (pairEncode u v).length + 2 have := length_pairEncode u v; omega⟩, Function.update (fun _ _ => none) r (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)), fun _ => 0, []⟩ (headerRulerTM r).runFrom ((Cfg.init (0 : Fin 4) z).mapState Sum.inl) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e ∧ ∀ t < 2 * ℓ + 3, ((headerRulerTM r).runFrom ((Cfg.init (0 : Fin 4) z).mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done) :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_mapState_mk
head.header: private theorem f6_mapState_mk {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (q : Option S) (i : Fin (x.length + 2)) (w : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (h : Fin k → ℤ) (o : List Bool) : (⟨q, i, w, h, o⟩ : Cfg k Bool S x).mapState f = ⟨q.map f, i, w, h, o⟩ :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_hosted
head.header: private theorem f6_hosted {K : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM (K + 3) Bool S) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Q) (inj : S → Bool → Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ (u y : List Bool) (bank : Fin (K + 3) → ℤ → Option Bool) (T : ℕ) {R : Type} (q : R), M.runFrom (M.initCfg y) T = ⟨none, 1, bank, fun _ => 0, []⟩ → (∀ v < T, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg y) v).state ≠ none) → let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2 let hp : ℓ + 1 < (pairEncode u y).length + 2 := by have :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_ruler_moves
head.header: private theorem f6_ruler_moves {K : ℕ} {z : List Bool} {S₃ S₄ S₆ : Type} (bank : Fin (K + 3) → ℤ → Option Bool) (ℓ N : ℕ) (hp : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) (hN : N + 1 < z.length + 2) (q₃ : S₃) (q₄ : S₄) (q₆ : S₆) : let r : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3) let W := Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank let WN := Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true)) bank let e₃ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool S₃ z := ⟨some q₃, ⟨ℓ + 1, hp⟩, W, fun _ => 0, []⟩ let f₃ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z := ⟨some .done, ⟨ℓ + 1, hp⟩, W, Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) r ((ℓ : ℤ) + 1), []⟩ let e₄ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool S₄ z := ⟨some q₄, ⟨ℓ + 1, hp⟩, W, Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) r ((ℓ : ℤ) + 1), []⟩ let f₄ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z := ⟨some .done, ⟨ℓ + 1, hp⟩, W, Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) r (ℓ : ℤ), []⟩ let e₆ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool S₆ z := ⟨some q₆, ⟨N + 1, hN⟩, WN, Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) r (N : ℤ), []⟩ let f₆ : Cfg (K + 4) Bool RewindPhase z := ⟨some .done, ⟨N + 1, hN⟩, WN, fun _ => 0, []⟩ ((skipTM (K + 4) r).runFrom (e₃.mapState fun _ => .run) (ℓ + 1) = f₃ ∧ ∀ t < ℓ + 1, ((skipTM (K + 4) r).runFrom (e₃.mapState fun _ => .run) t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ ((walkTM (Symbol := Bool) (K + 4) r (· = r) .neg).runFrom (e₄.mapState fun _ => .run) 1 = f₄ ∧ ∀ t < 1, ((walkTM (Symbol := Bool) (K + 4) r (· = r) .neg).runFrom (e₄.mapState fun _ => .run) t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ ((rewindTM (K + 4) r).runFrom (e₆.mapState fun _ => .start) (N + 2) = f₆ ∧ ∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM (K + 4) r).runFrom (e₆.mapState fun _ => .start) t).state ≠ some .done) :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_scan
head.header: private theorem f6_scan {K : ℕ} {z : List Bool} {S : Type} (bank : Fin (K + 3) → ℤ → Option Bool) (ℓ : ℕ) (hp : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) (q : S) (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ℓ = pairEncode u v) : let ℓ₂ := 2 * u.length + 2 let r : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3) let hp' : ℓ + ℓ₂ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by have h :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_prefix
head.header: private theorem f6_prefix (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (A : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool P) (finish : P) (C : ℕ), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ T₀ : ℕ, ∀ u x : List Bool, let ℓ := (2 * u.length + 2) + (2 * α.length + 2) let z := pairEncode u (pairEncode α x) let hp : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by show (2 * u.length + 2) + (2 * α.length + 2) + 1 < (pairEncode u (pairEncode α x)).length + 2 have h1 :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_loop
head.header: private theorem f6_loop (K : ℕ) : ∃ (Q V : Type) (_ : Fintype V) (_ : DecidableEq V) (H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool V) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V), ∀ {n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))), ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ (x z : List Bool) (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length), 0 < ℓ → z.drop ℓ = x → ∀ t : ℕ, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state = none → let ec := embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : 3 ≤ K + 3)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) let c := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0 ∃ t' : ℕ, (H.runFrom c t').state = none ∧ (H.runFrom c t').output = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output ∧ ∀ i, H.spaceUsedByTape c t' i ≤ M.spaceUsed (M.initCfg x) t + (2 * D + 1) + ℓ + 3 :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_last_ruler_layout
head.header: private theorem f6_last_ruler_layout (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type} (finish : P) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V) (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool) (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) : let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega) let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x := ⟨some finish, 1, fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ let physical : Cfg ((K + 3) + 1) Bool P z := ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩, Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes, fun _ => 0, []⟩ physical.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) = rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0 :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_cast_init_run
head.header: private theorem f6_cast_init_run {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).runFrom ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t = (h ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) t : Cfg n Bool P z) :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_cast_init_space
head.header: private theorem f6_cast_init_space {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).spaceUsed ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t = A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) t :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_cast_cfg_state

head.name: Complexity.f6_cast_cfg_embedding
head.header: private theorem f6_cast_cfg_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) : (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool Q z) = embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_cast_back_embedding
head.header: private theorem f6_cast_back_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) : (h.symm ▸ embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c : Cfg m Bool Q z) = c :=

head.name: Complexity.f6_final_seam
head.header: private theorem f6_final_seam (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type} [DecidableEq P] (A : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool P) (finish : P) (H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool V) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V) (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool) (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) : let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega) let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x := ⟨some finish, 1, fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ let d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool P z := ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩, Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes, fun _ => 0, []⟩ let c := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0 ∀ (T t B S : ℕ), (A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T = d) → (∀ u < T, (A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish) → (A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) T ≤ B) → (1 ≤ S) → (∀ i, H.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) → let A0 : MultiTapeTM (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P := (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)).symm ▸ A let U0 := startupLoopTM (k := K + 2) (K := 0) A0 finish H (inj entry false) let U : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) := (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)) ▸ U0 U.runFrom (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) = (H.runFrom c t).mapState Sum.inr ∧ U.spaceUsed (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + 4) * S :=

head.name: Complexity.space_universal
head.header: theorem space_universal : ∃ SU : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (s : ℕ) (x output : List Bool) (t : ℕ), ((TimeHierarchy.code).decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → ((TimeHierarchy.code).decode α).toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed (((TimeHierarchy.code).decode α).toFinTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s → ∃ t' : ℕ, SU.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (Nat.bits s) (pairEncode α x)) output t' ∧ SU.tm.spaceUsed (SU.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (Nat.bits s) (pairEncode α x))) t' ≤ C * s :=

head.name: Complexity.sph_code_window
head.header: private lemma sph_code_window (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : SpaceConstructible f) (hfg : ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, A * f n ≤ g n) (U₀ : FinTM Bool) (hU : ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (w output : List Bool) (t s : ℕ), (TimeHierarchy.code.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t → (TimeHierarchy.code.decode α).toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed ((TimeHierarchy.code.decode α).toFinTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t ≤ s → ∃ t' : ℕ, U₀.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t' ∧ U₀.tm.spaceUsed (U₀.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t' ≤ C * (s + 1)) (L : Language Bool) (c₀ : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (hM : M.DecidesInSpace L (fun n => c₀ * f n)) : ∃ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), U₀.ComputesInTime x [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x] t ∧ U₀.tm.spaceUsed (U₀.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ g x.length ∧ t = U₀.configBound x.length (g x.length) ∧ windowRun U₀.tm (g x.length) summaryTag (t + 1) (U₀.tm.initCfg x) 0 = (.halted, U₀.tm.runFrom (U₀.tm.initCfg x) t, outSummaryCode (outSummary [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x])) :=

head.name: Complexity.sphRightTM

base.name: Turing.catalog_trace_clauses
base.header: private lemma catalog_trace_clauses {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (touched : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred touched] (F R : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (D : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (L : ℕ) (htrace : ∀ t, M.runFrom d t = catalogTrace F R D L t) (hF : ∀ r, (F r).state = some .sweep ∧ ∀ j, (F r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) else 0) (hR : ∀ r, (R r).state = some .rewind ∧ ∀ j, (R r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0) (hD : D.state = some .done ∧ D.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) : (∀ t < 2 * L + 2, (M.runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * L + 2 → if touched j then (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (L : ℤ)) else (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.catalog_transferMap_trace
base.header: private lemma catalog_transferMap_trace {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) : (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t = catalogTrace (catalogSweepF src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) d) (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length) { d with state := some .done workTapes := (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length 0).workTapes } w.length t :=

base.name: Turing.transferMapTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem transferMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.header: theorem transferTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then none else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint
base.header: theorem Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = src ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then none else if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src)) :=

base.name: Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint
base.header: theorem Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src)) :=

base.name: Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem clearTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (clearTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then none else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg
base.header: theorem incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = some v) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done true) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2 → if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ((w.takeWhile id).length : ℤ)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg
base.header: theorem incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = none) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done false) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length false) (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.transferTM_run
base.header: theorem transferTM_run (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : ∃ T ≤ 3 * (w src).length + 3, (∀ t < T, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src)) :=

base.name: Turing.transferTM_spaceUsedByTape
base.header: theorem transferTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : ℕ) : (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ src → j ≠ dst → (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1 :=

base.name: Turing.copyTM_run
base.header: theorem copyTM_run (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : ∃ T ≤ 3 * (w src).length + 3, (∀ t < T, ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w dst (w src)) :=

base.name: Turing.clearTM_run
base.header: theorem clearTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ((clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w i []) :=

base.name: Turing.clearTM_spaceUsedByTape

base.name: Turing.compareTM_run
base.header: theorem compareTM_run (k : ℕ) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ v : Bool, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done v)) ∧ (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done (decide (w fst = w snd))) w :=

base.name: Turing.compareTM_spaceUsedByTape
base.header: theorem compareTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t fst ≤ min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 ∧ (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t snd ≤ min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ fst → j ≠ snd → (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1 :=

base.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_succ
base.header: theorem incrementTM_run_succ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = some v) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done true) (Function.update w i v) :=

base.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow
base.header: theorem incrementTM_run_overflow (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = none) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done false) (Function.update w i (List.replicate (w i).length false)) :=

base.name: Turing.incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape
base.header: theorem incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t i ≤ (w i).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ i → (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1 :=

base.name: Turing.capture_visitedByTapeHead
base.header: theorem capture_visitedByTapeHead {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool), host.tr (emb s) inp w = captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc)) (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) : (∀ i : Fin k, host.visitedByTapeHead (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc = tm.visitedByTapeHead c₀ t i ∧ host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc = tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ t i) ∧ host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t (Fin.last k) ≤ (tm.runFrom c₀ t).output.length - c₀.output.length + 1 :=

base.header: private lemma f2_scanCopy_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S) (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩ | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩) (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length), tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) j = f2_scanCfg x (some q) j hj (out ++ x.take j) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_incFixed_cases
base.header: private lemma f2_incFixed_cases (x : List Bool) : (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ incFixed x = none) ∨ ∃ j rest, x = List.replicate j true ++ false :: rest ∧ incFixed x = some (List.replicate j false ++ true :: rest) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_first

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_block
base.header: private lemma f2_extract_block (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool) (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) : (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) 2 = if b = c then f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) (a ++ [b]) (a ++ [b]).length [] else if b then f2_extractCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a a.length [] else f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) [] :=

base.header: private lemma f2_extract_replay (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length), (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) j = f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a j (if first then a.take j else []) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_replay_finish
base.header: private lemma f2_extract_replay_finish (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) (a.length + 1) = f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) i hi a a.length (if first then a else []) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_suffix
base.header: private lemma f2_extract_suffix (first : Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) : ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest), (f2_pairExtractTM first true).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length out) (rest.length + 1) = f2_extractCfg x none x.length (by omega) a a.length (out ++ rest) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_finish
base.header: private lemma f2_extract_finish (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (hx : x = pre ++ rest) : ∃ t ≤ 2 * a.length + rest.length + 3, ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).output = (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then rest else []) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_run
base.header: private lemma f2_extract_run (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest), ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 2 * a.length + 5, ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).output = match pairDecode rest with

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairExtract_computes
base.header: private lemma f2_pairExtract_computes (first second : Bool) (x : List Bool) : (f2_pairExtractTM first second).ComputesInTime x (match pairDecode x with | some (a, b) => (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then b else []) | none => []) (5 * (x.length + 1)) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_loop
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_loop {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) : ∀ i (hi : i < c + 1) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (_hh : ∀ k, k.val ≤ i → h k = 0) (o : List Bool) (r j : ℕ), j + r = q → (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop ⟨i, hi⟩) (Function.update h ⟨i, hi⟩ (j : ℤ)) o) (r * (f2_catalogPolyCost q C i + 2) + q + 2) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) h (o ++ List.replicate (r * (C * q ^ i)) true) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyTape_write
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPolyTape_write (q : ℕ) : Function.update (f2_catalogPolyTape q) (q : ℤ) (some true) = f2_catalogPolyTape (q + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCost_le
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPolyCost_le (q C : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∀ r, f2_catalogPolyCost q C r ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * r) * q ^ r :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg
base.header: private def f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : Cfg (c + 1) Bool (f2_CatalogPolyControl c C) x :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_copy
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_copy (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x) i = f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg c C x i hi :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_setup
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_setup (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q), (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q .setup (fun _ => (j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_start
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_start (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x) (2 * (x.length + 1)) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x (x.length + 1) (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes (c C : ℕ) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true) (fun n => (C + 5 * (c + 1) + 4) * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1)) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads
base.header: private def f2_polyHeads {d C : ℕ} (q : ℕ) (s : Option (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C)) (h : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ) : Prop :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads_bounds
base.header: private lemma f2_polyHeads_bounds {d C q : ℕ} {s : Option (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C)} {h : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ} (hp : f2_polyHeads q s h) (j : Fin (d + 1)) : -1 ≤ h j ∧ h j ≤ q :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_step
base.header: private lemma f2_poly_step {d C q : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (hq : 0 < q) (c : Cfg (d + 1) Bool (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C) x) (hw : c.workTapes = fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q) (hp : f2_polyHeads q c.state c.workTapePos) : ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapes = (fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q) ∧ f2_polyHeads q ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).state ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapePos :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_head_steps
base.header: private lemma f2_head_steps {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : c.workTapePos i - (t : ℤ) ≤ (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ∧ (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ≤ c.workTapePos i + (t : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_space
base.header: private lemma f2_poly_space (d C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.spaceUsed ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ (5 * (d + 1)) * (x.length + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc
base.header: private def f2_counterInc : List Bool → List Bool

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterCarry
base.header: private def f2_counterCarry : List Bool → ℕ

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_potential
base.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_potential (bs : List Bool) : (f2_counterInc bs).count true + f2_counterCarry bs = bs.count true + 1 :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_bits
base.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_bits (n : ℕ) : f2_counterInc n.bits = (n + 1).bits :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_length
base.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_length (bs : List Bool) : (f2_counterInc bs).length ≤ bs.length + 1 ∧ f2_counterCarry bs ≤ (f2_counterInc bs).length :=

base.header: private def f2_counterCfg (x : List Bool) (q : Fin 4) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (z : ℤ) (bs out : List Bool) : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin 4) x :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_read
base.header: private lemma f2_counterTape_read (pre bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length = bs.head? :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_write
base.header: private lemma f2_counterTape_write (pre bs : List Bool) (b : Bool) : Function.update (f2_counterTape (pre ++ bs)) (pre.length : ℤ) (some b) = f2_counterTape (pre ++ b :: bs.tail) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry_step
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) = if bs.head? = some true then f2_counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) [] else f2_counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool, f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) (f2_counterCarry bs + 1) = f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + f2_counterCarry bs - 1) (pre ++ f2_counterInc bs) [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_rewind
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length), f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) = f2_counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_start
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_start (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) (bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) = f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 1 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_increment
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) (bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) (2 * f2_counterCarry bs + 2) = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (f2_counterInc bs) [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧ f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_emit_run
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length), f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i = f2_counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_emit
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_emit (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : let c := f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) (bs.length + 1) c.state = none ∧ c.output = bs :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_computes
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_computes : f2_counterTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count_space
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_count_space (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧ f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] ∧ ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 1, -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤ (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_heads
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_heads (x : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (j : Fin 1) : -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤ (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_space
base.header: private lemma f2_counter_space (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : f2_counterTM.tm.spaceUsed (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ 5 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) :=

base.header: private def f2_pairCountTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenCfg
base.header: private def f2_lenCfg (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (r : ℕ) : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (f2_pairCountTM M).State x :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenCfg_read
base.header: private lemma f2_lenCfg_read (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (r : ℕ) : (f2_lenCfg M c q i hi r).inputSymbol = x[i]? :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenAction_apply
base.header: private lemma f2_lenAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q q' : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i j r s : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hj : j ≤ x.length) (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool) (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) (hd : (r : ℤ) - 1 + d.cast = (s : ℤ) - 1) : (f2_lenAction M m d b q').apply (f2_lenCfg M c q i hi r) = {f2_lenCfg M c q' j hj s with output := b.toList} :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenSuffix_run
base.header: private lemma f2_lenSuffix_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length → ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1, ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output = [decide (rest.length ≤ r)] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_first
base.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_first (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b : Bool) (r : ℕ) (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) : (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.step (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) = f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr (some b)))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_block
base.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_block (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b d : Bool) (r : ℕ) (hx : x = pre ++ b :: d :: rest) : (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) 2 = if b = d then f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) r else if b then {f2_lenCfg M c none (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r with output := [false]} else f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) r :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_run
base.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length → ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1, ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output = [match pairDecode rest with | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ r) | none => false] :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogRewind
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogRewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenStart
base.header: private lemma f2_lenStart (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w T) : ∃ t ≤ T + x.length + 4, ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.output = w ∧ (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.initCfg x) t = f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) 0 (by omega) c.output.length :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairCount_computes
base.header: private lemma f2_pairCount_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime g T) : (f2_pairCountTM M).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [match pairDecode x with | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ (g x).length) | none => false]) (fun n => T n + 2 * n + 5) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPair_inverse
base.header: private lemma f2_catalogPair_inverse (x : List Bool) : ∀ a v, pairDecode x = some (a, v) → x = pairEncode a v :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed

base.header: theorem computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed

base.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed

base.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun z => match pairDecode z with | some (a, b) => a ++ b | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed

base.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_unary_sharp

base.header: private lemma f2_splitSolve_of_body (C e : ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (A : ℕ) (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1), (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k [])) (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if f2_splitAccept C e w s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (f2_splitStep w s))) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧ ∀ x t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_round
base.header: private lemma a2_loop_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool} (s next : List Bool) (accepted : Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t B : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor) (hend : if accepted then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) (hspace : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u ≤ B) (hf : a2_heads fuel B) : ∃ v, (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧ ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).state = none ∨ ∃ v, (f2_loopDebit word).2 = true ∧ (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧ (f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v = f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) true none (f2_loopDebit word).1 fuel :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed
base.header: theorem exists_loopTM_spaceUsed (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T S : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) (hFspace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length) (hstartSpace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), t ≤ T x.length → body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length) (hroundSpace : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∀ t ≤ T x.length, body.tm.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t ≤ S x.length) : ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), E.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))]) (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (S x.length + T x.length + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg
base.header: theorem compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * compareStop u v + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * compareStop u v + 2, ∀ b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * compareStop u v + 2 → if j = fst ∨ j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (compareStop u v : ℤ)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.compareTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem compareTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length, (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * δ + 2 → if j = fst ∨ j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (δ : ℤ)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem walkTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src : Fin k) (moved : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (hsrc : moved src) (dir : SignType) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + (dir : ℤ) * p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0 } ∧ (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 → ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * (t : ℤ) else 0) :=

base.name: Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem skipTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (skipTM k i).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + w.length + 1) } ∧ (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 → if j = i then ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + w.length + 1) else ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.seekEndTM_run_ofCfg

base.name: Turing.mealyRun_induction

base.name: Turing.mealyRun_next
base.header: private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) : (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧ (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 :=

base.name: Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg
base.header: theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ a, ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

base.name: Turing.scanResult_shiftLeft

base.name: Turing.scanResult_carry

head.name: Turing.catalog_trace_clauses
head.header: private lemma catalog_trace_clauses {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (touched : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred touched] (F R : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (D : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (L : ℕ) (htrace : ∀ t, M.runFrom d t = catalogTrace F R D L t) (hF : ∀ r, (F r).state = some .sweep ∧ ∀ j, (F r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) else 0) (hR : ∀ r, (R r).state = some .rewind ∧ ∀ j, (R r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0) (hD : D.state = some .done ∧ D.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) : (∀ t < 2 * L + 2, (M.runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * L + 2 → if touched j then (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (L : ℤ)) else (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.catalog_transferMap_trace
head.header: private lemma catalog_transferMap_trace {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) : (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t = catalogTrace (catalogSweepF src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) d) (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length) { d with state := some .done workTapes := (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length 0).workTapes } w.length t :=

head.name: Turing.catalog_compare_trace
head.header: private lemma catalog_compare_trace {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) (δ : ℕ) (hδ : δ ≤ min u.length v.length) (hp : ∀ r < δ, ∃ b, u[r]? = some b ∧ v[r]? = some b) (hs : ¬∃ b, u[δ]? = some b ∧ v[δ]? = some b) (he : (u[δ]? = v[δ]?) ↔ u = v) (t : ℕ) : (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t = catalogTrace (catalogCompareF fst snd d) (catalogCompareR fst snd d (decide (u = v))) { d with state := some (.done (decide (u = v))) } δ t :=

head.name: Turing.transferMapTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem transferMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.copyMapTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem copyMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem transferTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then none else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint
head.header: theorem Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = src ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then none else if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src)) :=

head.name: Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem copyTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (copyTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = src ∨ j = dst then ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint
head.header: theorem Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src)) :=

head.name: Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem clearTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (clearTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then none else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg
head.header: theorem incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = some v) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done true) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2 → if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ((w.takeWhile id).length : ℤ)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg
head.header: theorem incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = none) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done false) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length false) (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.transferTM_run
head.header: theorem transferTM_run (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : ∃ T ≤ 3 * (w src).length + 3, (∀ t < T, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src)) :=

head.name: Turing.transferTM_spaceUsedByTape
head.header: theorem transferTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : ℕ) : (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ src → j ≠ dst → (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1 :=

head.name: Turing.copyTM_run
head.header: theorem copyTM_run (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : ∃ T ≤ 3 * (w src).length + 3, (∀ t < T, ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w dst (w src)) :=

head.name: Turing.copyTM_spaceUsedByTape
head.header: theorem copyTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : ℕ) : (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ src → j ≠ dst → (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1 :=

head.name: Turing.clearTM_run
head.header: theorem clearTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ((clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧ (clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w i []) :=

head.name: Turing.clearTM_spaceUsedByTape

head.name: Turing.compareTM_run
head.header: theorem compareTM_run (k : ℕ) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ v : Bool, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done v)) ∧ (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done (decide (w fst = w snd))) w :=

head.name: Turing.compareTM_spaceUsedByTape
head.header: theorem compareTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t fst ≤ min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 ∧ (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t snd ≤ min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ fst → j ≠ snd → (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1 :=

head.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_succ
head.header: theorem incrementTM_run_succ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = some v) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done true) (Function.update w i v) :=

head.name: Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow
head.header: theorem incrementTM_run_overflow (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = none) : ∃ T ≤ 2 * (w i).length + 2, (∀ t < T, ∀ b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done false) (Function.update w i (List.replicate (w i).length false)) :=

head.name: Turing.incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape
head.header: theorem incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t i ≤ (w i).length + 2 ∧ ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ i → (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1 :=

head.name: Turing.capture_visitedByTapeHead
head.header: theorem capture_visitedByTapeHead {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool), host.tr (emb s) inp w = captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc)) (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) : (∀ i : Fin k, host.visitedByTapeHead (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc = tm.visitedByTapeHead c₀ t i ∧ host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc = tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ t i) ∧ host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t (Fin.last k) ≤ (tm.runFrom c₀ t).output.length - c₀.output.length + 1 :=

head.header: private lemma f2_extract_suffix (first : Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) : ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest), (f2_pairExtractTM first true).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length out) (rest.length + 1) = f2_extractCfg x none x.length (by omega) a a.length (out ++ rest) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_finish
head.header: private lemma f2_extract_finish (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (hx : x = pre ++ rest) : ∃ t ≤ 2 * a.length + rest.length + 3, ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).output = (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then rest else []) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_run
head.header: private lemma f2_extract_run (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest), ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 2 * a.length + 5, ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).output = match pairDecode rest with
