head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_rewind
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_rewind {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q), (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.rewind i) (Function.update h i ((j : ℤ) - 1)) o) (j + 1) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩) (Function.update h i 0) o :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_advance
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_advance {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.step (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) h o) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop i) (Function.update h i (h i + 1)) o :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCost
head.header: private def f2_catalogPolyCost (q C : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_loop
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_loop {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) : ∀ i (hi : i < c + 1) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (_hh : ∀ k, k.val ≤ i → h k = 0) (o : List Bool) (r j : ℕ), j + r = q → (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop ⟨i, hi⟩) (Function.update h ⟨i, hi⟩ (j : ℤ)) o) (r * (f2_catalogPolyCost q C i + 2) + q + 2) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) h (o ++ List.replicate (r * (C * q ^ i)) true) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyTape_write
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPolyTape_write (q : ℕ) : Function.update (f2_catalogPolyTape q) (q : ℤ) (some true) = f2_catalogPolyTape (q + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCost_le
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPolyCost_le (q C : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∀ r, f2_catalogPolyCost q C r ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * r) * q ^ r :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg
head.header: private def f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : Cfg (c + 1) Bool (f2_CatalogPolyControl c C) x :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_copy
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_copy (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x) i = f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg c C x i hi :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_setup
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_setup (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q), (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q .setup (fun _ => (j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_start
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_start (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x) (2 * (x.length + 1)) = f2_catalogPolyCfg x (x.length + 1) (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes (c C : ℕ) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true) (fun n => (C + 5 * (c + 1) + 4) * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads
head.header: private def f2_polyHeads {d C : ℕ} (q : ℕ) (s : Option (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C)) (h : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ) : Prop :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads_bounds
head.header: private lemma f2_polyHeads_bounds {d C q : ℕ} {s : Option (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C)} {h : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ} (hp : f2_polyHeads q s h) (j : Fin (d + 1)) : -1 ≤ h j ∧ h j ≤ q :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_step
head.header: private lemma f2_poly_step {d C q : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (hq : 0 < q) (c : Cfg (d + 1) Bool (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C) x) (hw : c.workTapes = fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q) (hp : f2_polyHeads q c.state c.workTapePos) : ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapes = (fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q) ∧ f2_polyHeads q ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).state ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapePos :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_head_steps
head.header: private lemma f2_head_steps {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : c.workTapePos i - (t : ℤ) ≤ (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ∧ (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ≤ c.workTapePos i + (t : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_space
head.header: private lemma f2_poly_space (d C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.spaceUsed ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ (5 * (d + 1)) * (x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc
head.header: private def f2_counterInc : List Bool → List Bool

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterCarry
head.header: private def f2_counterCarry : List Bool → ℕ

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_potential
head.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_potential (bs : List Bool) : (f2_counterInc bs).count true + f2_counterCarry bs = bs.count true + 1 :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_bits
head.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_bits (n : ℕ) : f2_counterInc n.bits = (n + 1).bits :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterInc_length
head.header: private lemma f2_counterInc_length (bs : List Bool) : (f2_counterInc bs).length ≤ bs.length + 1 ∧ f2_counterCarry bs ≤ (f2_counterInc bs).length :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterBump
head.header: private def f2_counterBump (d : SignType) (w : Option Bool) : Action 1 Bool (Fin 4) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTM
head.header: private def f2_counterTM : FinTM Bool

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape
head.header: private def f2_counterTape (bs : List Bool) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterCfg
head.header: private def f2_counterCfg (x : List Bool) (q : Fin 4) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (z : ℤ) (bs out : List Bool) : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin 4) x :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_read
head.header: private lemma f2_counterTape_read (pre bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length = bs.head? :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_write
head.header: private lemma f2_counterTape_write (pre bs : List Bool) (b : Bool) : Function.update (f2_counterTape (pre ++ bs)) (pre.length : ℤ) (some b) = f2_counterTape (pre ++ b :: bs.tail) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry_step
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) = if bs.head? = some true then f2_counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) [] else f2_counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool, f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) (f2_counterCarry bs + 1) = f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + f2_counterCarry bs - 1) (pre ++ f2_counterInc bs) [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_rewind
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length), f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) = f2_counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_start
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_start (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) (bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) = f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 1 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_increment
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) (bs : List Bool) : f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) (2 * f2_counterCarry bs + 2) = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (f2_counterInc bs) [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧ f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_emit_run
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length), f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i = f2_counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_emit
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_emit (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) : let c := f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) (bs.length + 1) c.state = none ∧ c.output = bs :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_computes
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_computes : f2_counterTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count_space
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_count_space (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length), ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧ f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t = f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] ∧ ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 1, -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤ (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_heads
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_heads (x : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (j : Fin 1) : -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧ (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤ (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_space
head.header: private lemma f2_counter_space (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : f2_counterTM.tm.spaceUsed (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ 5 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenAction
head.header: private def f2_lenAction (M : FinTM Bool) (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool) (q : Option (M.State ⊕ (Fin 4 ⊕ Option Bool))) : Action (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State ⊕ (Fin 4 ⊕ Option Bool)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairCountTM
head.header: private def f2_pairCountTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenCfg
head.header: private def f2_lenCfg (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (r : ℕ) : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (f2_pairCountTM M).State x :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenCfg_read
head.header: private lemma f2_lenCfg_read (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (r : ℕ) : (f2_lenCfg M c q i hi r).inputSymbol = x[i]? :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenAction_apply
head.header: private lemma f2_lenAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q q' : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State) (i j r s : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hj : j ≤ x.length) (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool) (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) (hd : (r : ℤ) - 1 + d.cast = (s : ℤ) - 1) : (f2_lenAction M m d b q').apply (f2_lenCfg M c q i hi r) = {f2_lenCfg M c q' j hj s with output := b.toList} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenSuffix_run
head.header: private lemma f2_lenSuffix_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length → ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1, ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output = [decide (rest.length ≤ r)] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_first
head.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_first (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b : Bool) (r : ℕ) (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) : (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.step (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) = f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr (some b)))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_block
head.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_block (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b d : Bool) (r : ℕ) (hx : x = pre ++ b :: d :: rest) : (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) 2 = if b = d then f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) r else if b then {f2_lenCfg M c none (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r with output := [false]} else f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) r :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_run
head.header: private lemma f2_lenParse_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length → ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1, ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output = [match pairDecode rest with | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ r) | none => false] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogRewind
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogRewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenStart
head.header: private lemma f2_lenStart (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w T) : ∃ t ≤ T + x.length + 4, ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.output = w ∧ (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.initCfg x) t = f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) 0 (by omega) c.output.length :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairCount_computes
head.header: private lemma f2_pairCount_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime g T) : (f2_pairCountTM M).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [match pairDecode x with | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ (g x).length) | none => false]) (fun n => T n + 2 * n + 5) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPair_inverse
head.header: private lemma f2_catalogPair_inverse (x : List Bool) : ∀ a v, pairDecode x = some (a, v) → x = pairEncode a v :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_space_of_time
head.header: private lemma f2_space_of_time {M : FinTM Bool} {x y : List Bool} {T : ℕ} (h : M.ComputesInTime x y T) (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (T + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime id (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => w) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (Nat.size x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e)) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairEncodeFixed_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairEncodeFixed_spaceUsed (α : List Bool) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => pairEncode α x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd).getD []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(pairDecode x).isSome]) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun z => match pairDecode z with | some (a, b) => a ++ b | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => pairEncode x x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_unary_sharp
head.header: private lemma f2_unary_sharp (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) (fun n => a * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_first_length
head.header: private lemma f2_first_length (x : List Bool) : (((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length ≤ x.length :=

anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).k Bool (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ), startup ≤ c * (T x.length + 1) ∧ (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧ (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧ (cfg (R x.length + anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true]) else (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) ∧ (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∀ j, -(T x.length : ℤ) ≤ (cfg i).workTapePos j ∧ (cfg i).workTapePos j ≤ T x.length) ∧ (∀ j, -((T x.length + c * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ∧ (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ≤ (T x.length + c * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitCount_run

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitRestore_first
head.header: private lemma f2_splitRestore_first (k : ℕ) (w s : List Bool) : ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 2 * s.length + w.length + 5 ∧ (∀ j < t, ((f2_splitRestoreTM k).tm.runFrom (f2_splitRestoreScan k w s 0) j).state ≠ some (4, false)) ∧ (f2_splitRestoreTM k).tm.runFrom (f2_splitRestoreScan k w s 0) t = Cfg.ofWords (4, false) (stateWord (k + 1) (f2_splitStep w s)) :=

head.header: private lemma f2_splitEmbed_cut {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {w : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H) (emb : S → H) (anchor : H) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop] (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor) (hfix : ∀ c : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, c.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step c = c) (hagree : ∀ q, ¬stop q → ∀ inp work, host.tr (emb q) inp work = (tm.tr q inp work).mapState emb) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ) (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) : ∃ t ≤ T, host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) t = d.mapState emb ∧ f2_splitSafe host anchor (c.mapState emb) t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_count
head.header: private lemma f2_splitBody_count (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s : List Bool) (out : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hT : M.tm.runFrom (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) T = f2_splitBank M s none out) : ∃ t ≤ T, (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s (some start) [])) t = f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s none out) ∧ f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor (f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s (some start) [])) t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_restore
head.header: private lemma f2_splitBody_restore (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s : List Bool) : ∃ t ≤ 2 * s.length + w.length + 5, (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((f2_splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState f2_SplitBodyState.restore) t = Cfg.ofWords (.restore (4, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) (f2_splitStep w s)) ∧ f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor ((f2_splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState f2_SplitBodyState.restore) t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitEmit_suffix

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitEmit_run
head.header: private lemma f2_splitEmit_run (k : ℕ) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) : (f2_splitEmitTM k).tm.runFrom (f2_splitEmitCfg k w s (some 0) 0 0 []) (s.length + w.length + 3) = f2_splitEmitCfg k w s none w.length s.length (pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_round
head.header: private lemma f2_splitBody_round (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s out : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hT : M.tm.runFrom (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) T = f2_splitBank M s none out) : ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T + 5 * s.length + 3 * w.length + 20 ∧ (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧ if decide (s.length + out.length = w.length) then ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).state = none ∧ ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) else (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) (f2_splitStep w s)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSolve_of_body
head.header: private lemma f2_splitSolve_of_body (C e : ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (A : ℕ) (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1), (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k [])) (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if f2_splitAccept C e w s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (f2_splitStep w s))) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧ ∀ x t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSource_constant

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_envelope

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSolve_closed
head.header: private lemma f2_splitSolve_closed (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧ ∀ x t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=

head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.catalog_redirect_apply

head.name: Turing.FinTM.catalog_redirect_step

head.name: Turing.FinTM.catalog_redirect_run
head.header: private lemma catalog_redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t = catalog_redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_timed_control_init

head.header: private lemma f2_timed_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) : (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (f2_timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b) t = f2_timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads b :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_timedReadyCfg
head.header: private def f2_timedReadyCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) : Cfg (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_timed_read

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_timed_start

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_cond_time
head.header: private lemma f2_cond_time {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool} {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀) (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) : (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) :=

head.header: private def f2_finSumEquiv (a b : ℕ) : Fin a ⊕ Fin b ≃ Fin (a + b)

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_sum_add
head.header: private lemma f2_sum_add {a b : ℕ} (f : Fin (a + b) → ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin (a + b), f i) = (∑ i : Fin a, f (Fin.castAdd b i)) + ∑ i : Fin b, f (Fin.natAdd a i) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_branch_space
head.header: private lemma f2_branch_space (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t = if b then M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t + M₂.k else M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t + M₁.k :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_condHeads
head.header: private def f2_condHeads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (d : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k) → ℤ) (z : ℤ) : Fin ((D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1) → ℤ :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_control_heads
head.header: private lemma f2_control_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) : (f2_timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).workTapePos = f2_condHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) c.output.length :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_branch_heads
head.header: private lemma f2_branch_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) : (f2_timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b).workTapePos = f2_condHeads D M₁ M₂ heads c.workTapePos 0 :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_read_heads
head.header: private lemma f2_read_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) : ∀ u ≤ 2, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧ ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (f2_timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) u).workTapePos = f2_condHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) z :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_cond_ledger
head.header: private lemma f2_cond_ledger (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ) (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) : ∀ u, ∃ v ≤ T, ∃ w ≤ u, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧ ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos = f2_condHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_cond_space
head.header: private lemma f2_cond_space (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ) (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) : (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T + (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2 :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool} {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (sD s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀) (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) (hsD : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ sD x.length) (hs₁ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₁ x.length) (hs₂ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₂ x.length) : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ sD x.length + max (s₁ x.length) (s₂ x.length) + c :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_source_radius
head.header: private lemma a2_source_radius {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (t B : ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c.workTapePos i = 0) (hb : tm.spaceUsed c t ≤ B) (i : Fin k) : -(B : ℤ) ≤ (tm.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ∧ (tm.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ≤ B :=

head.header: private def a2_heads {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (B : ℕ) : Prop :=

head.header: private lemma a2_heads_mono {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} {c : Cfg k Bool Q x} {A B : ℕ} (h : a2_heads c A) (hle : A ≤ B) : a2_heads c B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_heads_steps
head.header: private lemma a2_heads_steps {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (A B t : ℕ) (h : a2_heads c A) (ht : t ≤ B) : a2_heads (tm.runFrom c t) (A + B) :=

head.header: private lemma a2_heads_join {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (a b B : ℕ) (ha : ∀ u ≤ a, a2_heads (tm.runFrom c u) B) (hb : ∀ u ≤ b, a2_heads (tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c a) u) B) : ∀ u ≤ a + b, a2_heads (tm.runFrom c u) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_heads_halted
head.header: private lemma a2_heads_halted {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (a B : ℕ) (hh : (tm.runFrom c a).state = none) (ha : ∀ u ≤ a, a2_heads (tm.runFrom c u) B) : ∀ u, a2_heads (tm.runFrom c u) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_call_heads
head.header: private lemma a2_call_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool} (startup : Bool) (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (B : ℕ) (hb : a2_heads c B) (hf : a2_heads fuel B) (ho : c.output.length ≤ B) : a2_heads (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_fuel_heads
head.header: private lemma a2_fuel_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (B : ℕ) (hf : a2_heads c B) (ho : c.output.length ≤ B) : a2_heads (f2_loopFuelCaptured body F c) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_call_run
head.header: private lemma a2_call_run (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode startup : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (t : ℕ) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state ≠ none) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨ (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) : (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release none word fuel) t = f2_loopCall body F anchor startup (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false) (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none) word fuel :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_call_prefix
head.header: private lemma a2_call_prefix (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (startup : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (t B : ℕ) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state ≠ none) (hzero : ∀ i, c.workTapePos i = 0) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨ (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) (hspace : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed c u ≤ B) (hf : a2_heads fuel B) (hout : (body.tm.runFrom c t).output.length ≤ B) : ∀ u ≤ t, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release none word fuel) u) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_prepare
head.header: private lemma a2_loop_prepare (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (R T S : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hspace : ∀ x t, F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length) (x : List Bool) : ∃ (c : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t : ℕ), c.state = none ∧ c.output = Nat.bits (R x.length) ∧ t ≤ 5 * T x.length + 7 ∧ (f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.initCfg x) t = f2_loopReady body F c ∧ a2_heads c (S x.length) ∧ ∀ u ≤ t, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.initCfg x) u) (S x.length + 4 * (Nat.bits (R x.length)).length + 4) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_start_prefix
head.header: private lemma a2_loop_start_prefix (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool} (s : List Bool) (t B : ℕ) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hguard : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some anchor) (hend : body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) (hs : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) u ≤ B) (hf : a2_heads fuel B) : ∀ u ≤ t + 2, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopReady body F fuel) u) (B + 2) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_round
head.header: private lemma a2_loop_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool} (s next : List Bool) (accepted : Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t B : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor) (hend : if accepted then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) (hspace : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u ≤ B) (hf : a2_heads fuel B) : ∃ v, (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧ ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).state = none ∨ ∃ v, (f2_loopDebit word).2 = true ∧ (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧ (f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v = f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) true none (f2_loopDebit word).1 fuel :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_segments
head.header: private lemma a2_segments {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool Q x) (N B : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hround : ∀ i < N, ∃ u, (∀ v ≤ u, a2_heads (tm.runFrom (cfg i) v) B) ∧ ((tm.runFrom (cfg i) u).state = none ∨ i + 1 < N ∧ tm.runFrom (cfg i) u = cfg (i + 1))) : ∀ t, a2_heads (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t) B :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_halted_run
head.header: private lemma a2_loop_halted_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x) (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ) (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [false]) (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B, if accept j then (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true] else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) : ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept] :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem exists_loopTM_spaceUsed (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T S : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) (hFspace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length) (hstartSpace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), t ≤ T x.length → body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length) (hroundSpace : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∀ t ≤ T x.length, body.tm.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t ≤ S x.length) : ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), E.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))]) (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (S x.length + T x.length + 1) :=

head.header: theorem step_of_tapeAction_move {Symbol State : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q) (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q') : M.step c = { c with state := some q' inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) } :=

head.name: Turing.step_of_tapeAction_write

head.name: Turing.compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg
head.header: theorem compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * compareStop u v + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * compareStop u v + 2, ∀ b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * compareStop u v + 2 → if j = fst ∨ j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (compareStop u v : ℤ)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.compareTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem compareTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length, (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * δ + 2 → if j = fst ∨ j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (δ : ℤ)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem walkTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src : Fin k) (moved : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (hsrc : moved src) (dir : SignType) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + (dir : ℤ) * p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0 } ∧ (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 → ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * (t : ℤ) else 0) :=

head.name: Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem skipTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (skipTM k i).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + w.length + 1) } ∧ (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 → if j = i then ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + w.length + 1) else ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem skipBackTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) : (skipBackTM k i).runFrom d (u.length + 3) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1) } ∧ (∀ t < u.length + 3, ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ u.length + 3 → if j = i then ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j) else ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.seekEndTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem seekEndTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hne : ws ≠ []) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = fieldsTape ws p) : (seekEndTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧ (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1, ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1 → if j = i then ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + fieldOffset ws ws.length) else ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.seekStartTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem seekStartTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hcur : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) ≠ none) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -2 ≤ p → p < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length + p) = fieldsTape ws p) : (seekStartTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧ (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4, ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4 → if j = i then ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - fieldOffset ws ws.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j) else ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.name: Turing.mealyRun_induction
head.header: private theorem mealyRun_induction {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (P : A → List Γ → A × List Γ → Prop) (hnil : ∀ a, P a [] (a, [])) (hcons : ∀ a γ l r, P (δ a γ).1 l r → P a (γ :: l) (r.1, (δ a γ).2 :: r.2)) (a : A) (l : List Γ) : P a l (mealyRun δ a l) :=

head.name: Turing.mealyRun_length
head.header: private theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) : (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length :=

head.name: Turing.mealyRun_next
head.header: private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) : (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧ (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 :=

head.name: Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } ∧ (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ a, ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 → if j = i then ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) else ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) :=

head.header: theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ) : scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w = ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: w.map get)) :=

head.name: Turing.scanResult_shiftLeft
head.header: theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ) : scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w = ((w.map get).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀])) :=

head.name: Turing.scanResult_carry
head.header: theorem scanResult_carry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ) : scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w = (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++ (w.dropWhile top).drop 1) :=

base.name: Turing.exists_rulerTestTM
base.header: theorem exists_rulerTestTM : ∃ (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool P) (entry yes no : P) (C : ℕ), yes ≠ no ∧ ∀ {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool P z), d.state = some entry → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val → (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some (if d.inputPos.val = ℓ then yes else no) } :=

base.name: Turing.rd_test_window
base.header: private theorem rd_test_window {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool rd_State z) (hd : d.state = some (.inl ())) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val) (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ 2 * ℓ + 2) : (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧ d.workTapePos 0 - 1 ≤ (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ≤ d.workTapePos 0 + ℓ ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).state ≠ none ∧ (u < 2 * ℓ + 2 → ∀ b, (rd_test.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (.inr (b, true))) :=

base.name: Turing.rd_test_return

base.name: Turing.exists_rulerDeviceTM
base.header: theorem exists_rulerDeviceTM : ∃ (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool P) (readEntry : P) (readExit : Option Bool → P) (moveEntry : SignType → P) (moveExit : P) (C : ℕ), Function.Injective readExit ∧ (∀ v, readExit v ≠ moveExit) ∧ ∀ {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool P z) (i : Fin (y.length + 2)), RulerAt ℓ 0 d i → (d.state = some readEntry → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (readExit v)) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some (readExit (inputCell y i.val)) }) ∧ (∀ m : SignType, d.state = some (moveEntry m) → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some moveExit) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ (R.runFrom d t).state = some moveExit ∧ (R.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = ℓ + (moveInputPos i m).val ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧ (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output) :=

base.name: Turing.rd_host_block

base.name: Turing.exists_rulerHostTM
base.header: theorem exists_rulerHostTM {m : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (H : MultiTapeTM (m + 1) Bool Q) (inj : S → Bool → Q) (C : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length), 0 < ℓ → z.drop ℓ = y → ∀ (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ), (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → rt (rp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) → ∀ (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool), (b = true ↔ c.inputPos.val = 0) → ∀ t : ℕ, let d := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (c.state.map fun q => inj q b) c rt rp ∃ t', t ≤ t' ∧ t' ≤ C * (ℓ + 1) * t ∧ (∃ b' : Bool, (b' = true ↔ (M.runFrom c t).inputPos.val = 0) ∧ H.runFrom d t' = rulerHostCfg ℓ hz ((M.runFrom c t).state.map fun q => inj q b') (M.runFrom c t) rt rp) ∧ ((∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) → ∀ u < t', (H.runFrom d u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t', ∃ v ≤ t, (∀ i : Fin m, (H.runFrom d u).workTapes i.castSucc = (M.runFrom c v).workTapes i ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapePos i.castSucc = (M.runFrom c v).workTapePos i) ∧ (H.runFrom d u).output = (M.runFrom c v).output ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapes (Fin.last m) = rt ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapePos (Fin.last m) ∈ Finset.Icc (rp - 1) (rp + ℓ)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, H.visitedByTapeHead d t' i.castSucc = M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ H.visitedByTapeHead d t' (Fin.last m) ⊆ Finset.Icc (rp - 1) (rp + ℓ) :=

head.name: Turing.exists_rulerTestTM
head.header: theorem exists_rulerTestTM : ∃ (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool P) (entry yes no : P) (C : ℕ), yes ≠ no ∧ ∀ {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool P z), d.state = some entry → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val → (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some (if d.inputPos.val = ℓ then yes else no) } :=

head.name: Turing.rd_test_window
head.header: private theorem rd_test_window {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool rd_State z) (hd : d.state = some (.inl ())) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val) (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ 2 * ℓ + 2) : (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧ d.workTapePos 0 - 1 ≤ (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ≤ d.workTapePos 0 + ℓ ∧ (rd_test.runFrom d u).state ≠ none ∧ (u < 2 * ℓ + 2 → ∀ b, (rd_test.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (.inr (b, true))) :=

head.name: Turing.rd_test_return
head.header: private theorem rd_test_return {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool rd_State z) (hd : d.state = some (.inl ())) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val) (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) : rd_test.runFrom d (2 * ℓ + 2) = { d with state := some (.inr (rd_verdict d ℓ, true)) } :=

head.name: Turing.exists_rulerDeviceTM
head.header: theorem exists_rulerDeviceTM : ∃ (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool P) (readEntry : P) (readExit : Option Bool → P) (moveEntry : SignType → P) (moveExit : P) (C : ℕ), Function.Injective readExit ∧ (∀ v, readExit v ≠ moveExit) ∧ ∀ {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg 1 Bool P z) (i : Fin (y.length + 2)), RulerAt ℓ 0 d i → (d.state = some readEntry → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (readExit v)) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some (readExit (inputCell y i.val)) }) ∧ (∀ m : SignType, d.state = some (moveEntry m) → ∃ t ≤ C * (ℓ + 1), (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some moveExit) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 - d.workTapePos 0| ≤ ((ℓ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧ (R.runFrom d t).state = some moveExit ∧ (R.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = ℓ + (moveInputPos i m).val ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧ (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output) :=

head.name: Turing.rd_pause_run
head.header: private theorem rd_pause_run {m : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) {z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (d : Cfg (m + 1) Bool (rd_HostState S) z) (q : S) (hd : d.state = some (rd_resume q (.inl ()))) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val) (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → d.workTapes (Fin.last m) (d.workTapePos (Fin.last m) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) : (rd_hostTM M).runFrom d (2 * ℓ + 2) = { d with state := some (.inl (q, decide (d.inputPos.val = ℓ))) } ∧ (∀ u ≤ 2 * ℓ + 2, ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d u).state ≠ none ∧ ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d u).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d u).workTapePos i.castSucc = d.workTapePos i.castSucc) ∧ ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧ ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d u).workTapePos (Fin.last m) ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos (Fin.last m) - 1) (d.workTapePos (Fin.last m) + ℓ)) :=

head.name: Turing.rd_host_block
head.header: private theorem rd_host_block {m : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hdrop : z.drop ℓ = y) (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ) (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → rt (rp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) (c : Cfg m Bool S y) : (rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) (rd_hostCost M ℓ c) = rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp (M.step c) ∧ (c.state ≠ none → ∀ u < rd_hostCost M ℓ c, ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∀ u ≤ rd_hostCost M ℓ c, rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp c ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u) ∨ rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp (M.step c) ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u)) :=

head.name: Turing.exists_rulerHostTM
head.header: theorem exists_rulerHostTM {m : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (H : MultiTapeTM (m + 1) Bool Q) (inj : S → Bool → Q) (C : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length), 0 < ℓ → z.drop ℓ = y → ∀ (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ), (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) → rt (rp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) → ∀ (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool), (b = true ↔ c.inputPos.val = 0) → ∀ t : ℕ, let d := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (c.state.map fun q => inj q b) c rt rp ∃ t', t ≤ t' ∧ t' ≤ C * (ℓ + 1) * t ∧ (∃ b' : Bool, (b' = true ↔ (M.runFrom c t).inputPos.val = 0) ∧ H.runFrom d t' = rulerHostCfg ℓ hz ((M.runFrom c t).state.map fun q => inj q b') (M.runFrom c t) rt rp) ∧ ((∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) → ∀ u < t', (H.runFrom d u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t', ∃ v ≤ t, (∀ i : Fin m, (H.runFrom d u).workTapes i.castSucc = (M.runFrom c v).workTapes i ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapePos i.castSucc = (M.runFrom c v).workTapePos i) ∧ (H.runFrom d u).output = (M.runFrom c v).output ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapes (Fin.last m) = rt ∧ (H.runFrom d u).workTapePos (Fin.last m) ∈ Finset.Icc (rp - 1) (rp + ℓ)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, H.visitedByTapeHead d t' i.castSucc = M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ H.visitedByTapeHead d t' (Fin.last m) ⊆ Finset.Icc (rp - 1) (rp + ℓ) :=

base.name: Turing.seamCompTM_step
base.header: theorem seamCompTM_step {k : ℕ} {S₁ S₂ : Type} [DecidableEq S₁] {x : List Bool} (A : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit₁ : S₁) (B : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry₂ exit₂ : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Bool S₁ x} {c₂ : Cfg k Bool S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : A.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hx₁ : c₁.state = some exit₁) (hcut₁ : ∀ t < T₁, (A.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit₁) (h₂ : B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) T₂ = c₂) (hx₂ : c₂.state = some exit₂) (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂, (B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) t).state ≠ some exit₂) : (seamCompTM A exit₁ B entry₂).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂) ∧ (c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂)).state = some (Sum.inr exit₂) ∧ ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, ((seamCompTM A exit₁ B entry₂).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr exit₂) :=

base.name: Turing.prefixCanon_pairExtract_halt
base.header: theorem prefixCanon_pairExtract_halt (first : Bool) (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : let F := if first then FinTM.pairExtractTM true false else FinTM.pairExtractTM false true let M := prefixCanonTM F let z := pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x let d := M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg z) (16 * (Nat.bits t).length + 8 * α.length + 25) d.state = none ∧ d.output = (if first then Nat.bits t else α) ∧ d.inputPos.val = 4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 :=

base.name: Turing.embedSilentRetTM_firstReturn
base.header: theorem embedSilentRetTM_firstReturn {k : ℕ} (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (ι : Fin M.k ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (halt : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).state = none) : ∃ u ≤ T, (embedSilentRetTM ι cap M.tm).runFrom ((embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] out (M.tm.initCfg x)).mapState Sum.inl) u = { embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] out (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T) with state := some (Sum.inr ()) } ∧ ∀ v < u, ((embedSilentRetTM ι cap M.tm).runFrom ((embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] out (M.tm.initCfg x)).mapState Sum.inl) v).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ()) :=

base.header: theorem embedSilentCfg_initCfg {m n : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (x : List Bool) : (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] [] (M.initCfg x)).mapState Sum.inl = Cfg.init (Sum.inl M.q₀ : S ⊕ Unit) x :=

base.name: Turing.headerCapture_run
base.header: theorem headerCapture_run (first : Bool) (K : ℕ) (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ι : Fin (prefixCanonTM (if first then FinTM.pairExtractTM true false else FinTM.pairExtractTM false true)).k ↪ Fin K) (cap : Fin K) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (tapes : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin K → ℤ) (out : List Bool) : let M := prefixCanonTM (if first then FinTM.pairExtractTM true false else FinTM.pairExtractTM false true) let z := pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x let start := (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] out (M.tm.initCfg z)).mapState Sum.inl ∃ T ≤ 16 * (Nat.bits t).length + 8 * α.length + 25, let e := (embedSilentRetTM ι cap M.tm).runFrom start T e.state = some (Sum.inr ()) ∧ e.inputPos.val = 4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 ∧ e.workTapes cap = FinTM.bufferTape (if first then Nat.bits t else α) ∧ e.workTapePos cap = ((if first then Nat.bits t else α).length : ℤ) ∧ e.output = out ∧ (∀ j : Fin K, j ∉ Set.range ι → j ≠ cap → e.workTapes j = tapes j ∧ e.workTapePos j = heads j) ∧ ∀ u < T, ((embedSilentRetTM ι cap M.tm).runFrom start u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ()) :=

base.name: Turing.exists_windowCall
base.header: theorem exists_windowCall (K : ℕ) (j dst : Fin K) (hjd : j ≠ dst) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (W : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (d : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)), d.state = some entry → d.inputPos.val = 4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 → (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ ((Nat.bits t).length : ℤ) → d.workTapes j (d.workTapePos j + q) = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t) q) → d.workTapes dst = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos dst = 0 → ∃ T ≤ C * (min t x.length + 1) + 2 * (Nat.bits t).length, (W.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧ (W.runFrom d T).inputPos.val = 4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 + (x.take t).length ∧ (W.runFrom d T).workTapes dst = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t) ∧ (W.runFrom d T).workTapePos dst = ((x.take t).length : ℤ) ∧ (W.runFrom d T).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j ∧ (∀ i : Fin K, i ≠ j → i ≠ dst → (W.runFrom d T).workTapes i = d.workTapes i ∧ (W.runFrom d T).workTapePos i = d.workTapePos i) ∧ (W.runFrom d T).output = d.output ∧ ∀ u < T, (W.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_runFrom_left
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_runFrom_left {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) {c : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T : ℕ} (hcut : ∀ t < T, (M₁.runFrom c t).state ≠ some exit) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c.mapState Sum.inl) t = (M₁.runFrom c t).mapState Sum.inl :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_runFrom_right
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_runFrom_right {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (t : ℕ) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + t) = (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) t).mapState Sum.inr :=

head.name: Turing.seamComp_run_general
head.header: private lemma seamComp_run_general {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) T₂ = c₃) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = c₃.mapState Sum.inr :=

head.name: Turing.seamComp_firstReturn_general
head.header: private lemma seamComp_firstReturn_general {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry q₂ : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂, (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) t).state ≠ some q₂) : ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, ((seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂) :=

head.name: Turing.seamComp_visited_general
head.header: private lemma seamComp_visited_general {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (i : Fin k) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).visitedByTapeHead (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ⊆ M₁.visitedByTapeHead c₀ T₁ i ∪ M₂.visitedByTapeHead (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) T₂ i :=

head.name: Turing.seam_ofWords_mapState
head.header: private lemma seam_ofWords_mapState {S₃ : Type*} (f : S₁ → S₃) (q : S₁) (w : Fin k → List Bool) : (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).mapState f = Cfg.ofWords (f q) w :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_run
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_run [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = Cfg.ofWords (Sum.inr q₂) w₂ :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_firstReturn
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_firstReturn [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂, (M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) t).state ≠ some q₂) : ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, ((seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂) :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) (i : Fin k) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ⊆ M₁.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ i ∪ M₂.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ i :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_spaceUsedByTape_le_add
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_spaceUsedByTape_le_add [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) (i : Fin k) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ≤ M₁.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ i + M₂.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ i :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) ≤ M₁.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ + M₂.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_spaceUsedByTape_le_max
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_spaceUsedByTape_le_max [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂) (entry : S₂) (start : S₁) (q₂ : S₂) (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ = Cfg.ofWords exit w₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ = Cfg.ofWords q₂ w₂) (i : Fin k) (hown : M₁.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ i = {0} ∨ M₂.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ i = {0}) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl start) w₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ≤ max (M₁.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start w₀) T₁ i) (M₂.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry w₁) T₂ i) :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_run_ofCfg

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) (q₂ : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (h₂ : M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) T₂ = c₃) (hq : c₃.state = some q₂) (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂, (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) t).state ≠ some q₂) : ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, ((seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂) :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg
head.header: theorem seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hexit : c₁.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ t < T₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) (i : Fin k) : (seamCompTM M₁ exit M₂ entry).visitedByTapeHead (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ⊆ M₁.visitedByTapeHead c₀ T₁ i ∪ M₂.visitedByTapeHead (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry) T₂ i :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM₂
head.header: def seamCompTM₂ {Symbol : Type*} {S₀ : Type*} [DecidableEq S₀] [DecidableEq S₁] (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀) (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol ((S₀ ⊕ S₁) ⊕ S₂) :=

head.name: Turing.seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg
head.header: theorem seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {S₀ : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₀] [DecidableEq S₁] (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀) (he : e₁ ≠ e₂) (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂) {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₀ x} {T₀ : ℕ} (h₀ : M₀.runFrom c₀ T₀ = c₁) (hcut : ∀ t < T₀, (M₀.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₁ ∧ (M₀.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₂) : (c₁.state = some e₁ → ∀ t : ℕ, (seamCompTM₂ M₀ e₁ e₂ M₁ entry₁ M₂ entry₂).runFrom ((c₀.mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl) (T₀ + 1 + t) = ((M₁.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₁) t).mapState Sum.inr).mapState Sum.inl) ∧ (c₁.state = some e₂ → ∀ t : ℕ, (seamCompTM₂ M₀ e₁ e₂ M₁ entry₁ M₂ entry₂).runFrom ((c₀.mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl) (T₀ + 1 + t) = (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) t).mapState Sum.inr) :=

head.name: Turing.seamReleaseTM_step_inr

head.name: Turing.seamReleaseTM_firstReturn
head.header: theorem seamReleaseTM_firstReturn {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (anchor : S) {c c' : Cfg k Symbol S x} {T : ℕ} (hc : c.state = some anchor) (hT : 0 < T) (h : M.runFrom c T = c') (hc' : c'.state = some anchor) (hcut : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < T → (M.runFrom c t).state ≠ some anchor) : (seamReleaseTM M anchor).runFrom (c.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) T = c'.mapState Sum.inr ∧ ∀ t < T, ((seamReleaseTM M anchor).runFrom (c.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr anchor) :=

head.name: Turing.seamReleaseTM_visitedByTapeHead

head.name: Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none
head.header: theorem phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) (hs : red i s = none) (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ) : (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = ((M i).tr s inp w).mapState (Sigma.mk i) :=

head.name: Turing.phaseHostTM_q₀
head.header: theorem phaseHostTM_q₀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) : (phaseHostTM M q0 red).q₀ = q0 :=

head.name: Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some
head.header: theorem phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) {q' : Σ i, Ph i} (hs : red i s = some q') (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ) : (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q'⟩ :=

head.name: Turing.phaseHostTM_run_le
head.header: theorem phaseHostTM_run_le {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ) (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) : ∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u = ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i) :=

head.name: Turing.phaseHostTM_run
head.header: theorem phaseHostTM_run {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ) (h : (M i).runFrom c T = c') (s' : Ph i) (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q') (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) : (∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u = ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i)) ∧ (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) (T + 1) = c'.mapState (fun _ => q') :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.succFieldTM_heads
base.header: lemma succFieldTM_heads {m n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src dst : Fin m) (hne : src ≠ dst) (copy : Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool SuccPhase x) (s : Option (Fin n)) (hq : d.state = some .tag) (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (optStateBits s).length), d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + r) = some ((optStateBits s)[r]'hr)) : ∀ t ≤ (optStateBits s).length, let e := (succFieldTM src dst copy).runFrom d t e.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ e.output = d.output ∧ ∀ j, e.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if j = src then (t : ℤ) else if copy = true ∧ j = dst then (t - 1 : ℕ) else 0 :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_path
base.header: private lemma recordSkipTM_path {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) (s : Option (Fin n)) (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀) (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i)) (hs : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (optStateBits s).length), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + recordWidth k + r) = some ((optStateBits s)[r]'hr)) : ∀ u ≤ recordWidth k + 1 + (optStateBits s).length, let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧ (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) else (0 : ℤ)) ∧ (u < recordWidth k + 1 + (optStateBits s).length → ∀ b, f.state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) :=
