base.header: private lemma rep_entry {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : d = atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 d.output) .entry () :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_effect
base.header: theorem roundTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧ let e := (roundTM k).runFrom d T e.state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧ Rep tr (a.apply c) e ∧ e.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = summaryEmit (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k)) a.output ∧ (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, let f := (roundTM k).runFrom d u (f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∨ f.inputPos = e.inputPos) ∧ |(f.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ∨ f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |f.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ if j.val < k then 1 else (50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → d.workTapePos j = 0 ∧ e.workTapePos j = 0 :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_visited
base.header: theorem roundTM_visited {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧ Rep tr (a.apply c) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (a.apply c).workTapePos i}) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_iterate
base.header: theorem roundTM_iterate {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℕ) : ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x), (∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom c u).state.isSome) → ∀ (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x), d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ → Rep M.tr c d → ∃ T, t ≤ T ∧ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c t) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_firstExit_unique
base.header: theorem roundTM_firstExit_unique {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : ∃! T, 0 < T ∧ (((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∨ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩ :=

head.header: lemma recordTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀) (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i)) (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) (hin : d.inputPos = c.inputPos) (htapes : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i) (hheads : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i) (hsum : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary c.output) : let e := (recordTM k).runFrom d (recordWidth k + 1) e.state = some none ∧ e.inputPos = (a.apply c).inputPos ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, e.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = (a.apply c).workTapes i ∧ e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = (a.apply c).workTapePos i) ∧ e.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary (a.apply c).output ∧ e.output = d.output ∧ (∀ u < recordWidth k + 1, ((recordTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some none) ∧ recordWidth k + 1 ≤ (actionBitsK a).length ∧ (∀ u ≤ recordWidth k + 1, let f := (recordTM k).runFrom d u (∀ i : Fin k, f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) + if u = recordWidth k + 1 then ((a.workTapes i).2 : ℤ) else 0) ∧ f.inputPos = (if u = recordWidth k + 1 then moveInputPos d.inputPos a.inputTape else d.inputPos) ∧ (∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |f.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ if j.val < k then 1 else (recordWidth k : ℤ)) ∧ |(f.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧ f.workTapePos (tableTape k) = d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + min u (recordWidth k) ∧ f.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = d.workTapePos (summaryTape k)) :=

head.header: private lemma succFieldTM_unary_step {m : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src dst : Fin m) (hne : src ≠ dst) (copy : Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool SuccPhase x) (w : List Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) (hw : d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + r) = some w[r]) : (succFieldTM src dst copy).step (succFieldCfg src dst copy d w r .unary) = succFieldCfg src dst copy d w (r + 1) (if w[r] = true then .unary else .done true) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.succFieldTM_heads
head.header: lemma succFieldTM_heads {m n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src dst : Fin m) (hne : src ≠ dst) (copy : Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool SuccPhase x) (s : Option (Fin n)) (hq : d.state = some .tag) (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (optStateBits s).length), d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + r) = some ((optStateBits s)[r]'hr)) : ∀ t ≤ (optStateBits s).length, let e := (succFieldTM src dst copy).runFrom d t e.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ e.output = d.output ∧ ∀ j, e.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if j = src then (t : ℤ) else if copy = true ∧ j = dst then (t - 1 : ℕ) else 0 :=

head.header: private lemma actionBitsK_reads {k n : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) = some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) : ∃ bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool, actionBitsK a = List.ofFn bits ++ optStateBits a.state ∧ (actionBitsK a).length = recordWidth k + (optStateBits a.state).length ∧ (∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i)) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (optStateBits a.state).length), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + recordWidth k + r) = some ((optStateBits a.state)[r]'hr)) :=

head.header: lemma recordSkipTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀) (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) = some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) : (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) = { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) } :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_path
head.header: private lemma recordSkipTM_path {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) (s : Option (Fin n)) (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀) (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i)) (hs : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (optStateBits s).length), d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + recordWidth k + r) = some ((optStateBits s)[r]'hr)) : ∀ u ≤ recordWidth k + 1 + (optStateBits s).length, let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧ (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) else (0 : ℤ)) ∧ (u < recordWidth k + 1 + (optStateBits s).length → ∀ b, f.state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.Rep_iff
head.header: theorem Rep_iff {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} {tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))} {c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x} {d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x} : Rep tr c d ↔ d.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i ∧ d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i) ∧ d.workTapes (tableTape k) = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK tr) ∧ d.workTapes (summaryTape k) = summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD []) ∧ d.workTapePos (tableTape k) = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = 0 :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_effect
head.header: theorem roundTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧ let e := (roundTM k).runFrom d T e.state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧ Rep tr (a.apply c) e ∧ e.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = summaryEmit (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k)) a.output ∧ (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, let f := (roundTM k).runFrom d u (f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∨ f.inputPos = e.inputPos) ∧ |(f.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ∨ f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |f.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ if j.val < k then 1 else (50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → d.workTapePos j = 0 ∧ e.workTapePos j = 0 :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_visited
head.header: theorem roundTM_visited {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧ Rep tr (a.apply c) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (a.apply c).workTapePos i}) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_iterate
head.header: theorem roundTM_iterate {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℕ) : ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x), (∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom c u).state.isSome) → ∀ (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x), d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ → Rep M.tr c d → ∃ T, t ≤ T ∧ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c t) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

head.header: theorem roundTM_firstExit_unique {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) : ∃! T, 0 < T ∧ (((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∨ ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧ ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩ :=

base.header: private lemma fl_block_phase {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T) (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live)) (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) : (∀ u ≤ T, (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u = ((fl_part k false).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) u).mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ∧ (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + 1) = ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).mapState (fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_round
base.header: private lemma fl_round {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T) (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live)) (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) : (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) = fl_flush (if live then some (fl_entry k) else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u < T + if live then 3 else 2, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u).state ≠ none) ∧ ∀ j, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) j ⊆ (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_step_exists
base.header: private lemma fl_step_exists {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (hl : c.state ≠ none) : ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 ∧ (fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t = forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M (M.step c) ∧ (∀ u < t, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (M.step c).workTapePos i}) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.exists_forwardLoopTM
base.header: theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))), ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ, Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧ (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧ cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧ ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) → (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_leaf_step
head.header: private lemma fl_leaf_step {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) x) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (some live)) : (fl_leafTM k).step d = fl_flush (if live then some none else none) d :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_leaf_run
head.header: private lemma fl_leaf_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) x) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (some live)) : (fl_leafTM k).runFrom d 1 = fl_flush (if live then some none else none) d :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_encode_map
head.header: private lemma fl_encode_map {k n : ℕ} {Q R : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q) (f : Q → R) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : (forwardLoopCfg entry M c).mapState f = forwardLoopCfg (f entry) M c :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_Ph
head.header: private def fl_Ph (k : ℕ) : Bool → Type

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_fintype
head.header: private instance fl_fintype (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) : Fintype (fl_Ph k b) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_decidableEq
head.header: private instance fl_decidableEq (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) : DecidableEq (fl_Ph k b) :=

head.header: private def fl_entry (k : ℕ) : Σ b, fl_Ph k b :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_part
head.header: private def fl_part (k : ℕ) : (b : Bool) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (fl_Ph k b)

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_red
head.header: private def fl_red (k : ℕ) : (b : Bool) → fl_Ph k b → Option (Σ b, fl_Ph k b)

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_TM
head.header: private def fl_TM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Σ b, fl_Ph k b) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_block_phase
head.header: private lemma fl_block_phase {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T) (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live)) (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) : (∀ u ≤ T, (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u = ((fl_part k false).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) u).mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ∧ (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + 1) = ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).mapState (fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_hosted_leaf
head.header: private lemma fl_hosted_leaf {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state ≠ none) : (fl_TM k).step (d.mapState fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) = fl_flush (if live then some ⟨true, none⟩ else none) d :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_return
head.header: private lemma fl_return {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) : (fl_TM k).step (fl_flush (some ⟨true, none⟩) d) = fl_flush (some (fl_entry k)) d :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_restore
head.header: private lemma fl_restore {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (hr : Rep M.tr c d) : fl_flush (c.state.map fun _ => entry) d = forwardLoopCfg entry M {c with output := d.output ++ (outputSummary c.output).toList} :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_round
head.header: private lemma fl_round {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T) (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live)) (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) : (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) = fl_flush (if live then some (fl_entry k) else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧ (∀ u < T + if live then 3 else 2, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u).state ≠ none) ∧ ∀ j, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) j ⊆ (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_step_exists
head.header: private lemma fl_step_exists {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (hl : c.state ≠ none) : ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 ∧ (fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t = forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M (M.step c) ∧ (∀ u < t, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (M.step c).workTapePos i}) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.fl_home
head.header: private lemma fl_home {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (j : Fin (k + 2)) (hj : k ≤ j.val) : (forwardLoopCfg entry M c).workTapePos j = 0 :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.exists_forwardLoopTM
head.header: theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))), ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ, Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧ (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧ cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧ ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) → (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧ ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆ Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ) :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState
base.header: theorem MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState {m : ℕ} {P Q : Type} (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (B : MultiTapeTM m Bool Q) (f : P → Q) (hq : B.q₀ = f A.q₀) (x : List Bool) : B.initCfg x = (A.initCfg x).mapState f :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_workTapes
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_workTapes {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) (j : Fin (k + 2)) : (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).workTapes j = if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_fields
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_fields {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) : (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).state = some entry ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).inputPos.val = 1 ∧ (∀ j, (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).workTapePos j = 0) ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).output = [] :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_halt_iff
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_halt_iff {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : ((StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M c).state = none ↔ c.state = none) ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M c).output = c.output :=

base.name: Turing.embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init
base.header: theorem embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init {k n K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} (exit : P) (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) : embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) = (⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x).mapState (fun _ => entry) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_forward
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoop_forward {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (hlock : Lockstep M L (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none}) (hcost : ∀ c, c.state ≠ none → cost c ≤ D) (t : ℕ) (hhalt : (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state = none) : ∃ t₀ ≤ t, (∀ u < t₀, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t₀, cost (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u)) ≤ D * t ∧ L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t₀, cost (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u)) = StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t) :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_live
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoop_live {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ) (hlock : Lockstep M L (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none}) (hpos : ∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c) (hlive : ∀ u, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u).state ≠ none) (v : ℕ) : (L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) v).state ≠ none :=

base.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_converse
base.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoop_converse {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (hlock : Lockstep M L (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none}) (hcost : ∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧ cost c ≤ D) (u : ℕ) (hhalt : (L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) u).state = none) : ∃ t, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧ (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output = (L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) u).output :=

base.name: Turing.startupLoopTM
base.header: noncomputable def startupLoopTM {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool (P ⊕ Q) :=

base.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_initCfg
base.header: theorem startupLoopTM_initCfg {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (x : List Bool) : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x = (R.initCfg x).mapState Sum.inl :=

base.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_live_of_le
base.header: theorem startupLoopTM_live_of_le {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (T : ℕ) (hlive : (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T).state ≠ none) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).runFrom ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) t).state ≠ none :=

base.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_runFrom
base.header: theorem startupLoopTM_runFrom {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x) (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T = d) (hexit : d.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) = embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c) (t : ℕ) : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).runFrom ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) = (embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (L.runFrom c t)).mapState Sum.inr :=

base.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le
base.header: theorem startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x) (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T = d) (hexit : d.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) = embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c) (t B S : ℕ) (hB : R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg x) T ≤ B) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hloop : ∀ i, L.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).spaceUsed ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + (k + 2)) * S :=

base.name: Turing.headerScanTM
base.header: def headerScanTM {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin 4)

base.name: Turing.headerScanCfg
base.header: def headerScanCfg {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (q : Fin 4) (t : ℕ) (ht : d.inputPos.val + t < z.length + 2) : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z :=

base.name: Turing.up_scan_zero
base.header: private theorem up_scan_zero {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (hd : d.state = some 0) : headerScanCfg i d 0 0 (by have := d.inputPos.isLt; omega) = d :=

base.name: Turing.up_scan_step
base.header: private theorem up_scan_step {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (q : Fin 4) (t : ℕ) (ht : d.inputPos.val + t < z.length + 1) (hq : q ≠ 3) (b : Bool) (hb : (headerScanCfg i d q t (by omega)).inputSymbol = some b) : (headerScanTM i).step (headerScanCfg i d q t (by omega)) = headerScanCfg i d (if q = 0 then if b = false then 1 else 2 else if q = 1 ∧ b = true then 3 else 0) (t + 1) (by omega) :=

base.name: Turing.up_scan_pair
base.header: private theorem up_scan_pair {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (p t : ℕ) (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + p) (a b : Bool) (rest : List Bool) (hz : z.drop (p + t) = a :: b :: rest) : let hlen : d.inputPos.val + (t + 2) < z.length + 2 := by have h :=

base.name: Turing.up_scan_header
base.header: private theorem up_scan_header {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (p : ℕ) (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + p) (u v : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (hz : z.drop (p + t) = pairEncode u v) : let hlen : d.inputPos.val + (t + (2 * u.length + 2)) < z.length + 2 := by have h :=

base.name: Turing.headerScanTM_run
base.header: theorem headerScanTM_run {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (p : ℕ) (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + p) (hd : d.state = some 0) (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop p = pairEncode u v) : let hlen : d.inputPos.val + (2 * u.length + 2) < z.length + 2 := by have h :=

base.name: Turing.headerScanCfg_ruler
base.header: theorem headerScanCfg_ruler {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (q : Fin 4) (t : ℕ) (ht : d.inputPos.val + t < z.length + 2) (m : ℕ) (hpre : ∀ a : ℤ, d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (m : ℤ) + a) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate m true) a) : ∀ a : ℤ, (headerScanCfg i d q t ht).workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (m : ℤ) + a) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (m + t) true) a :=

base.name: Turing.up_scan_ruler_blank
base.header: private theorem up_scan_ruler_blank {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (q : Fin 4) (t : ℕ) (ht : d.inputPos.val + t < z.length + 2) (hblank : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = none) : ∀ a : ℤ, (headerScanCfg i d q t ht).workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + a) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate t true) a :=

base.name: Turing.headerRulerTM
base.header: def headerRulerTM {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) :=

base.name: Turing.headerRulerTM_run
base.header: theorem headerRulerTM_run {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (p : ℕ) (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + p) (hd : d.state = some 0) (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop p = pairEncode u v) (hblank : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = none) : let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2 let hlen : d.inputPos.val + ℓ < z.length + 2 := by have h :=

base.name: Turing.suffixRulerCfg
base.header: def suffixRulerCfg {k K n : ℕ} {P : Type} (q : P) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (z : List Bool) (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) : Cfg (K + (k + 3)) Bool P z :=

base.name: Turing.rulerHostCfg_fields
base.header: theorem rulerHostCfg_fields {m : ℕ} {S Q : Type} {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length) (q : Option Q) (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ) : (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz q c rt rp).inputPos.val = ℓ + c.inputPos.val ∧ (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz q c rt rp).workTapes (Fin.last m) = rt ∧ (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz q c rt rp).workTapePos (Fin.last m) = rp ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz q c rt rp).workTapes i.castSucc = c.workTapes i) ∧ (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz q c rt rp).output = c.output :=

base.name: Turing.suffixRulerCfg_embed
base.header: theorem suffixRulerCfg_embed {k K n : ℕ} {P Q H : Type} {x z : List Bool} (exit : P) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → H) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) (hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) : let c := StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x) embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 3 ≤ K + (k + 3))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (c.state.map fun q => inj q false) c (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) = (suffixRulerCfg (K := K) exit M z ℓ hlen).mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState
head.header: theorem MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState {m : ℕ} {P Q : Type} (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (B : MultiTapeTM m Bool Q) (f : P → Q) (hq : B.q₀ = f A.q₀) (x : List Bool) : B.initCfg x = (A.initCfg x).mapState f :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_workTapes
head.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_workTapes {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) (j : Fin (k + 2)) : (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).workTapes j = if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_fields
head.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_init_fields {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) : (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).state = some entry ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).inputPos.val = 1 ∧ (∀ j, (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).workTapePos j = 0) ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).output = [] :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_halt_iff
head.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_halt_iff {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : ((StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M c).state = none ↔ c.state = none) ∧ (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M c).output = c.output :=

head.name: Turing.embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init
head.header: theorem embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init {k n K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} (exit : P) (entry : Q) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) : embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) = (⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x).mapState (fun _ => entry) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_forward
head.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoop_forward {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (hlock : Lockstep M L (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none}) (hcost : ∀ c, c.state ≠ none → cost c ≤ D) (t : ℕ) (hhalt : (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state = none) : ∃ t₀ ≤ t, (∀ u < t₀, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u).state ≠ none) ∧ (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t₀, cost (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u)) ≤ D * t ∧ L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t₀, cost (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u)) = StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t) :=

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_live

head.name: Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoop_converse
head.header: theorem StepBlock.forwardLoop_converse {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) (cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (hlock : Lockstep M L (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none}) (hcost : ∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧ cost c ≤ D) (u : ℕ) (hhalt : (L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) u).state = none) : ∃ t, (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧ (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output = (L.runFrom (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)) u).output :=

head.header: theorem startupLoopTM_live_of_le {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (T : ℕ) (hlive : (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T).state ≠ none) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).runFrom ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) t).state ≠ none :=

head.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_runFrom
head.header: theorem startupLoopTM_runFrom {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x) (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T = d) (hexit : d.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) = embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c) (t : ℕ) : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).runFrom ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) = (embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (L.runFrom c t)).mapState Sum.inr :=

head.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le
head.header: theorem startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x) (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T = d) (hexit : d.state = some exit) (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit) (hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) = embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c) (t B S : ℕ) (hB : R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg x) T ≤ B) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hloop : ∀ i, L.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).spaceUsed ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + (k + 2)) * S :=

head.name: Turing.suffixRulerCfg_embed
head.header: theorem suffixRulerCfg_embed {k K n : ℕ} {P Q H : Type} {x z : List Bool} (exit : P) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → H) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) (hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) : let c := StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x) embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 3 ≤ K + (k + 3))) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (c.state.map fun q => inj q false) c (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) = (suffixRulerCfg (K := K) exit M z ℓ hlen).mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) :=

head.header: theorem step_output_prepend (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (pre : List Symbol) : tm.step { cfg with output := pre ++ cfg.output } = { tm.step cfg with output := pre ++ (tm.step cfg).output } :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_prepend

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀

head.name: Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime.computes
head.header: theorem ComputesFunInTime.computes {M : FinTM Symbol} {f : List Symbol → List Symbol} {T : ℕ → ℕ} (h : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) : M.Computes f :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff
head.header: theorem computesInTime_iff (M : FinTM Symbol) (x w : List Symbol) (t : ℕ) : M.ComputesInTime x w t ↔ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output = w :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.Computes.exists_computesInTime_iff

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc
head.header: theorem MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (d : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (lo hi : ℤ) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, (tm.runFrom d u).workTapePos i ∈ Finset.Icc lo hi) : tm.spaceUsedByTape d t i ≤ (hi + 1 - lo).toNat :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_of_abs_le
head.header: theorem MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_of_abs_le {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (d : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t r : ℕ) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(tm.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ (r : ℤ)) : tm.spaceUsed d t ≤ k * (2 * r + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc

base.name: Turing.exists_selfStartupTM
base.header: theorem exists_selfStartupTM (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 3) Bool P) (exit : P), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ T B : ℕ, ∀ w : List Bool, R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T = ⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (c.decode α).tm.tr) else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin (c.decode α).tm.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ ∧ (∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T ≤ B :=

base.name: Turing.exists_selfUniversal
base.header: theorem exists_selfUniversal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U₀ : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (w output : List Bool) (t s : ℕ), (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t → (c.decode α).toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed ((c.decode α).toFinTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t ≤ s → ∃ t' : ℕ, U₀.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t' ∧ U₀.tm.spaceUsed (U₀.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t' ≤ C * (s + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.exists_selfStartupTM
head.header: theorem exists_selfStartupTM (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 3) Bool P) (exit : P), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ T B : ℕ, ∀ w : List Bool, R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T = ⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (c.decode α).tm.tr) else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin (c.decode α).tm.q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ ∧ (∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T ≤ B :=

head.name: Turing.exists_selfUniversal
head.header: theorem exists_selfUniversal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U₀ : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (w output : List Bool) (t s : ℕ), (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t → (c.decode α).toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed ((c.decode α).toFinTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t ≤ s → ∃ t' : ℕ, U₀.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t' ∧ U₀.tm.spaceUsed (U₀.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t' ≤ C * (s + 1) :=

base.header: def emitAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (i : Fin (w.length + 1)) : Action k Bool S :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.emit_run
base.header: lemma emit_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (htr : ∀ i inp work, tm.tr (e i) inp work = emitAction w e i) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some (e 0)) : ∀ t (ht : t ≤ w.length), (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = some (e ⟨t, by omega⟩) ∧ (tm.runFrom cfg t).output = cfg.output ++ w.take t :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.emit_halts

base.header: lemma leftCfg_apply {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (a : Action k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) : (leftAction l f a).apply (leftCfg f c tapes heads) = leftCfg f (a.apply c) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.leftCfg_step
base.header: lemma leftCfg_step {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = leftAction l f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd l i)))) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) : tm'.step (leftCfg f c tapes heads) = leftCfg f (tm.step c) tapes heads :=

base.header: lemma leftCfg_run {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = leftAction l f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd l i)))) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : tm'.runFrom (leftCfg f c tapes heads) t = leftCfg f (tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.rightCfg_run
base.header: lemma rightCfg_run {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM l Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = rightAction k f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd k i)))) (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : tm'.runFrom (rightCfg f c tapes heads) t = rightCfg f (tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads :=

base.header: theorem ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le {M : FinTM Bool} {x y : List Bool} {T : ℕ} (h : M.ComputesInTime x y T) (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (T + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_spaceUsed
base.header: theorem branchTM_spaceUsed (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t = if b then M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t + M₂.k else M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t + M₁.k :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan

base.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any
base.header: lemma rewind_from_any {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some start) : ∃ t, tm.runFrom cfg t = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind
base.header: lemma timed_rewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads
base.header: theorem rewind_scan_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S) (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan → cfg.inputPos.val = j → j ≤ x.length → ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_heads
base.header: theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧ ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks
base.header: def tapeBlocks {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (left : Fin k → α) (buffer : α) (right : Fin l → α) : Fin (k + (1 + l)) → α :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_left
base.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_left {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin k) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.castAdd (1 + l) i) = a i :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_buffer
base.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_buffer {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin 1) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.castAdd l i)) = b :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_right
base.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_right {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin l) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = c i :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape
base.header: def bufferTape {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) : Option Symbol :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nil
base.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_nil {Symbol : Type*} : bufferTape (Symbol := Symbol) [] = fun _ => none :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nat
base.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_nat {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (i : ℕ) : bufferTape w i = w[i]? :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_left
base.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_left {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) : bufferTape w (-1) = none :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_eq
base.header: theorem bufferTape_eq {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) : bufferTape w z = if 0 ≤ z then w[z.toNat]? else none :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg
base.header: theorem bufferTape_of_neg {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) {z : ℤ} (hz : z < 0) : bufferTape w z = none :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append
base.header: lemma bufferTape_append {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (b : Symbol) : bufferTape (w ++ [b]) = Function.update (bufferTape w) (w.length : ℤ) (some b) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag
base.header: def VirtualTag {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) : Prop :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag_iff
base.header: theorem VirtualTag_iff {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) : VirtualTag p b ↔ (p.val = 0 → b = false) ∧ (p.val = n + 1 → b = true) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove
base.header: def virtualMove (b : Bool) (inp : Option Bool) (m : SignType) : SignType :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualNextTag
base.header: def virtualNextTag (b : Bool) (m : SignType) : Bool :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_inputSymbol
base.header: lemma bufferTape_inputSymbol {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S w) : bufferTape w ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) = c.inputSymbol :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove_correct
base.header: lemma virtualMove_correct {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S w) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (m : SignType) : (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 + (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m : ℤ) = ((moveInputPos c.inputPos m).val : ℤ) - 1 ∧ VirtualTag (moveInputPos c.inputPos m) (virtualNextTag b (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m)) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM
base.header: def bufferedCompTM (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg
base.header: def bufferedFirstCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) : Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_init
base.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_init (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.initCfg x) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_step
base.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state ≠ none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.step c) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_run
base.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (t : ℕ) (h : ∀ s, s < t → (M₁.tm.runFrom c s).state ≠ none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) t = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.runFrom c t) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg
base.header: def bufferedSecondCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast
base.header: theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) : (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapes i = tapeBlocks tapes (bufferTape y) c.workTapes (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast
base.header: theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) : (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapePos i = tapeBlocks heads ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) c.workTapePos (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i) :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_step
base.header: lemma bufferedSecondCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.step c).inputPos b' ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.step c) b' p tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_run
base.header: lemma bufferedSecondCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) t = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.runFrom c t) b' p tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg
base.header: def bufferedScanCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (j : ℕ) : Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg_run
base.header: lemma bufferedScanCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : ∀ j, j ≤ y.length → (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedScanCfg M₁ M₂ y p tapes heads j) (j + 1) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_rewind
base.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_rewind (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state = none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) (c.output.length + 2) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg c.output) true c.inputPos c.workTapes c.workTapePos :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedComp_start
base.header: lemma bufferedComp_start (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t₁ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.ComputesInTime x y t₁) : ∃ (a : ℕ) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ), a ≤ t₁ + y.length + 2 ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.AgreeOn
base.header: def AgreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (Q : Set State) : Prop :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.agreeOn_iff
base.header: theorem agreeOn_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (Q : Set State) : M.AgreeOn N Q ↔ ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ inp work, M.tr q inp work = N.tr q inp work :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_eq_of_agreeOn
base.header: theorem step_eq_of_agreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {Q : Set State} (h : M.AgreeOn N Q) {input : List Symbol} (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (hq : ∀ q, c.state = some q → q ∈ Q) : N.step c = M.step c :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn
base.header: theorem runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {Q : Set State} (h : M.AgreeOn N Q) {input : List Symbol} (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) (hq : ∀ u < t, ∀ q, (M.runFrom c u).state = some q → q ∈ Q) : N.runFrom c t = M.runFrom c t :=

base.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_runFrom_independent
base.header: theorem branchTM_runFrom_independent (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b b' : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (t : ℕ) : let view : Bool → MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := fun tag => by rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ tag, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ tag] exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ tag).tm (view b).runFrom c t = (view b').runFrom c t :=

head.name: Turing.Action.apply_workTapes
head.header: lemma Action.apply_workTapes {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {input : List Symbol} (a : Action k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (i : Fin k) : (a.apply c).workTapes i = Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) ((a.workTapes i).1.getD (c.workTapeSymbols i)) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.emitAction
head.header: def emitAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (i : Fin (w.length + 1)) : Action k Bool S :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.emit_run
head.header: lemma emit_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (htr : ∀ i inp work, tm.tr (e i) inp work = emitAction w e i) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some (e 0)) : ∀ t (ht : t ≤ w.length), (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = some (e ⟨t, by omega⟩) ∧ (tm.runFrom cfg t).output = cfg.output ++ w.take t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.emit_halts
head.header: lemma emit_halts {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (htr : ∀ i inp work, tm.tr (e i) inp work = emitAction w e i) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some (e 0)) : (tm.runFrom cfg (w.length + 1)).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom cfg (w.length + 1)).output = cfg.output ++ w :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.controlAction
head.header: def controlAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (m : SignType) (q : Option S) : Action k Bool S :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.inputSymbol_at
head.header: lemma inputSymbol_at {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hp : cfg.inputPos.val = i + 1) : cfg.inputSymbol = x[i]? :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.leftAction
head.header: def leftAction {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} (l : ℕ) (f : S → S') (a : Action k Bool S) : Action (k + l) Bool S'

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rightAction
head.header: def rightAction {l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} (k : ℕ) (f : S → S') (a : Action l Bool S) : Action (k + l) Bool S'

head.name: Turing.FinTM.leftCfg
head.header: def leftCfg {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) : Cfg (k + l) Bool S' x

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rightCfg
head.header: def rightCfg {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) : Cfg (k + l) Bool S' x

head.name: Turing.FinTM.leftCfg_apply
head.header: lemma leftCfg_apply {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (a : Action k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) : (leftAction l f a).apply (leftCfg f c tapes heads) = leftCfg f (a.apply c) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rightCfg_apply
head.header: lemma rightCfg_apply {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (a : Action l Bool S) (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) : (rightAction k f a).apply (rightCfg f c tapes heads) = rightCfg f (a.apply c) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.leftCfg_step
head.header: lemma leftCfg_step {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = leftAction l f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd l i)))) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) : tm'.step (leftCfg f c tapes heads) = leftCfg f (tm.step c) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rightCfg_step
head.header: lemma rightCfg_step {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM l Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = rightAction k f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd k i)))) (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) : tm'.step (rightCfg f c tapes heads) = rightCfg f (tm.step c) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.leftCfg_run
head.header: lemma leftCfg_run {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = leftAction l f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd l i)))) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : tm'.runFrom (leftCfg f c tapes heads) t = leftCfg f (tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rightCfg_run
head.header: lemma rightCfg_run {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM l Bool S) (tm' : MultiTapeTM (k + l) Bool S') (f : S → S') (htr : ∀ q inp work, tm'.tr (f q) inp work = rightAction k f (tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd k i)))) (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : tm'.runFrom (rightCfg f c tapes heads) t = rightCfg f (tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM
head.header: def branchTM (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) : FinTM Bool

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_k
head.header: theorem branchTM_k (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).k = M₁.k + M₂.k :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_State
head.header: theorem branchTM_State (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).State = (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_computes
head.header: lemma branchTM_computes (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).ComputesInTime x w t ↔ (cond b M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le
head.header: theorem ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le {M : FinTM Bool} {x y : List Bool} {T : ℕ} (h : M.ComputesInTime x y T) (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (T + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_spaceUsed
head.header: theorem branchTM_spaceUsed (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t = if b then M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t + M₂.k else M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t + M₁.k :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.controlAction_apply
head.header: lemma controlAction_apply {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (m : SignType) (q : Option S) : (controlAction m q).apply cfg = {cfg with state := q, inputPos := moveInputPos cfg.inputPos m} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val
head.header: lemma moveInputPos_neg_val {n : ℕ} (pos : Fin (n + 2)) : (moveInputPos pos .neg).val = pos.val - 1 :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan
head.header: lemma rewind_scan {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S) (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) : ∀ (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan → cfg.inputPos.val ≤ x.length → tm.runFrom cfg (cfg.inputPos.val + 1) = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any
head.header: lemma rewind_from_any {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some start) : ∃ t, tm.runFrom cfg t = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind
head.header: lemma timed_rewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads
head.header: theorem rewind_scan_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S) (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan → cfg.inputPos.val = j → j ≤ x.length → ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_heads
head.header: theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S) (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan) | none => controlAction .pos dest) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) : ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧ ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks
head.header: def tapeBlocks {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (left : Fin k → α) (buffer : α) (right : Fin l → α) : Fin (k + (1 + l)) → α :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_left
head.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_left {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin k) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.castAdd (1 + l) i) = a i :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_buffer
head.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_buffer {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin 1) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.castAdd l i)) = b :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_right
head.header: @[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_right {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α) (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin l) : tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = c i :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape
head.header: def bufferTape {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) : Option Symbol :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nil
head.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_nil {Symbol : Type*} : bufferTape (Symbol := Symbol) [] = fun _ => none :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nat
head.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_nat {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (i : ℕ) : bufferTape w i = w[i]? :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_left
head.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_left {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) : bufferTape w (-1) = none :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_eq
head.header: theorem bufferTape_eq {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) : bufferTape w z = if 0 ≤ z then w[z.toNat]? else none :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg
head.header: theorem bufferTape_of_neg {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) {z : ℤ} (hz : z < 0) : bufferTape w z = none :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append
head.header: lemma bufferTape_append {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (b : Symbol) : bufferTape (w ++ [b]) = Function.update (bufferTape w) (w.length : ℤ) (some b) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag
head.header: def VirtualTag {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) : Prop :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag_iff
head.header: theorem VirtualTag_iff {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) : VirtualTag p b ↔ (p.val = 0 → b = false) ∧ (p.val = n + 1 → b = true) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove
head.header: def virtualMove (b : Bool) (inp : Option Bool) (m : SignType) : SignType :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualNextTag
head.header: def virtualNextTag (b : Bool) (m : SignType) : Bool :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_inputSymbol
head.header: lemma bufferTape_inputSymbol {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S w) : bufferTape w ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) = c.inputSymbol :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove_correct
head.header: lemma virtualMove_correct {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S w) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (m : SignType) : (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 + (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m : ℤ) = ((moveInputPos c.inputPos m).val : ℤ) - 1 ∧ VirtualTag (moveInputPos c.inputPos m) (virtualNextTag b (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m)) :=

head.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state ≠ none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.step c) :=

head.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (t : ℕ) (h : ∀ s, s < t → (M₁.tm.runFrom c s).state ≠ none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) t = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.runFrom c t) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg
head.header: def bufferedSecondCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast
head.header: theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) : (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapes i = tapeBlocks tapes (bufferTape y) c.workTapes (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast
head.header: theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) : (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapePos i = tapeBlocks heads ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) c.workTapePos (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i) :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_step
head.header: lemma bufferedSecondCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.step c).inputPos b' ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.step c) b' p tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_run
head.header: lemma bufferedSecondCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) t = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.runFrom c t) b' p tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg
head.header: def bufferedScanCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (j : ℕ) : Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg_run
head.header: lemma bufferedScanCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : ∀ j, j ≤ y.length → (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedScanCfg M₁ M₂ y p tapes heads j) (j + 1) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_rewind
head.header: lemma bufferedFirstCfg_rewind (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state = none) : (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) (c.output.length + 2) = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg c.output) true c.inputPos c.workTapes c.workTapePos :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedComp_start
head.header: lemma bufferedComp_start (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t₁ : ℕ) (h₁ : M₁.ComputesInTime x y t₁) : ∃ (a : ℕ) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ), a ≤ t₁ + y.length + 2 ∧ (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a = bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.AgreeOn
head.header: def AgreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (Q : Set State) : Prop :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.agreeOn_iff
head.header: theorem agreeOn_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (Q : Set State) : M.AgreeOn N Q ↔ ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ inp work, M.tr q inp work = N.tr q inp work :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_eq_of_agreeOn
head.header: theorem step_eq_of_agreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {Q : Set State} (h : M.AgreeOn N Q) {input : List Symbol} (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (hq : ∀ q, c.state = some q → q ∈ Q) : N.step c = M.step c :=

head.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn
head.header: theorem runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {Q : Set State} (h : M.AgreeOn N Q) {input : List Symbol} (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) (hq : ∀ u < t, ∀ q, (M.runFrom c u).state = some q → q ∈ Q) : N.runFrom c t = M.runFrom c t :=

head.name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_runFrom_independent
head.header: theorem branchTM_runFrom_independent (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b b' : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (t : ℕ) : let view : Bool → MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := fun tag => by rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ tag, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ tag] exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ tag).tm (view b).runFrom c t = (view b').runFrom c t :=

base.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn
