base.name: Turing.universal
base.header: theorem universal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool, (∀ (output : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output (C * (t + 1))) ∧ (∀ output : List Bool, (∃ t, U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output t) → ∃ t, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) :=

base.name: Turing.universal_quadratic
base.header: theorem universal_quadratic (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ (M₀ : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ), M₀.ComputesFunInTime f T → ∃ (α : List Bool) (C : ℕ), ∀ x : List Bool, U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) (f x) (C * (T x.length + 1) ^ 2) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCutInterpreter
base.header: private def timedCutInterpreter : MultiTapeTM 4 Bool UniversalControl

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Eval_reads
base.header: private lemma timedCut_Eval_reads {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q : UniversalControl) (table : List Bool) (tp : ℤ) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) : (universalEvalCfg base q table tp state sp).workTapeSymbols = universalFour (bufferTape table tp) (state sp) (base.workTapeSymbols 2) (base.workTapeSymbols 3) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Admin_apply
base.header: private lemma timedCut_Admin_apply {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q q' : UniversalControl) (table : List Bool) (tp : ℤ) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (dt ds : SignType) (w : Option (Option Bool)) : (universalAdmin q' dt (w, ds)).apply (universalEvalCfg base q table tp state sp) = universalEvalCfg base q' table (tp + (dt : ℤ)) (match w with | none => state | some b => Function.update state sp b) (sp + (ds : ℤ)) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Eval_step
base.header: private lemma timedCut_Eval_step {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q q' : UniversalControl) (table : List Bool) (tp : ℤ) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (dt ds : SignType) (w : Option (Option Bool)) (h : timedCutInterpreter.tr q base.inputSymbol (universalFour (bufferTape table tp) (state sp) (base.workTapeSymbols 2) (base.workTapeSymbols 3)) = universalAdmin q' dt (w, ds)) : timedCutInterpreter.step (universalEvalCfg base q table tp state sp) = universalEvalCfg base q' table (tp + (dt : ℤ)) (match w with | none => state | some b => Function.update state sp b) (sp + (ds : ℤ)) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_table_read
base.header: private lemma timedCut_table_read (l r : List Bool) (b : Bool) : bufferTape (l ++ b :: r) (l.length : ℤ) = some b :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_table_rewind
base.header: private lemma timedCut_table_rewind {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (initial : Bool) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) : ∀ j, j ≤ table.length → timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.rewindTable initial index) table (j - 1) state sp) (j + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.countFirst initial index) table 0 state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_count_run
base.header: private lemma timedCut_count_run {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (initial : Bool) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (bits : List Bool) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ (bits.flatMap fun b => [b, b]) ++ [false, true] ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.countFirst initial index) table l.length state sp) (2 * bits.length + 2) = universalEvalCfg base (if initial then .initialCopy else .initialSkip index) table (l.length + 2 * bits.length + 2) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_StateTape_append
base.header: private lemma timedCut_StateTape_append (n : ℕ) : Function.update (universalStateTape n) (n + 1 : ℤ) (some true) = universalStateTape (n + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_StateTape_end
base.header: private lemma timedCut_StateTape_end (n : ℕ) : universalStateTape n (n + 1) = none :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_state_rewind
base.header: private lemma timedCut_state_rewind {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q q' : UniversalControl) (table : List Bool) (tp : ℤ) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (hzero : state 0 = some false) (hother : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → state j ≠ some false) (hstop : ∀ inp work, work 1 = some false → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q' 0 (none, .pos)) (hscan : ∀ inp work, work 1 ≠ some false → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q 0 (none, .neg)) : ∀ j : ℕ, timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base q table tp state j) (j + 1) = universalEvalCfg base q' table tp state 1 :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_initial_skip
base.header: private lemma timedCut_initial_skip {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate n true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.initialSkip index) table l.length state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.group index) table (l.length + n + 1) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_unary_copy
base.header: private lemma timedCut_unary_copy {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q q' : UniversalControl) (doneMove : SignType) (table : List Bool) (htrue : ∀ inp work, work 0 = some true → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q .pos (some (some true), .pos)) (hfalse : ∀ inp work, work 0 = some false → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q' doneMove (none, 0)) (n j : ℕ) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate n true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base q table l.length (universalStateTape j) (j + 1)) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base q' table (l.length + n + (doneMove : ℤ)) (universalStateTape (j + n)) (j + n + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Interpreter_first
base.header: private lemma timedCut_Interpreter_first {x : List Bool} (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (table : List Bool) : timedCutInterpreter.step (timedCut_InterpreterInitial p table) = universalEvalCfg (timedCut_InterpreterBase p) (.rewindTable true 0) table (table.length - 1) (universalStateTape 0) 1 :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Interpreter_initialize
base.header: private lemma timedCut_Interpreter_initialize {x : List Bool} (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (table bits records : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (ht : table = pairEncode bits (List.replicate n true ++ false :: records)) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (timedCut_InterpreterInitial p table) (table.length + 2 * bits.length + 2 * n + 7) = universalEvalCfg (timedCut_InterpreterBase p) .main table (2 * bits.length + 2 + n + 1) (universalStateTape n) 1 :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_fixed
base.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_fixed {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (field : Fin 8) (tp : ℤ), field.val + n = 7 → timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem field) table tp state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.skipUnary dest rem) table (tp + n + 1) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_unary
base.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_unary {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate n true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipUnary dest rem) table l.length state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0) table (l.length + n + 1) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_record
base.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_record {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ universalRecordBits a ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp) (universalRecordBits a).length = universalEvalCfg base (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0) table (l.length + (universalRecordBits a).length) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_records
base.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_records {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (as : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1)))) (l r : List Bool) (rem : Fin 9) (hlen : as.length = rem.val + 1) (ht : table = l ++ as.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp) (as.flatMap universalRecordBits).length = universalEvalCfg base (universalSkipDone dest) table (l.length + (as.flatMap universalRecordBits).length) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_groups
base.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_groups {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))))) (hg : ∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) (l r : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (ht : table = l ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.group index) table l.length (universalStateWindow j groups.length) (j + 1)) (groups.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.rewindState (some index)) table (l.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length) (universalStateWindow (j + groups.length) 0) (j + groups.length + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_read_fixed
base.header: private lemma timedCut_read_fixed {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.ofFn bits ++ r) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (field : Fin 8) (old : Fin 8 → Bool), field.val + n = 7 → (∀ i : Fin 8, i.val < field.val → old i = bits i) → timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.readAction field old) table (l.length + field.val) state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.nextState bits) table (l.length + 8) state sp :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_NextCost

base.name: Turing.timedCut_prepare_next
base.header: private lemma timedCut_prepare_next {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (table : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (next : Option (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate (universalNextOnes next) true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.nextState bits) table l.length (universalStateTape 0) 1) (timedCut_NextCost next) = universalEvalCfg base (.applyRecord bits next.isNone) table (l.length + universalNextOnes next) (universalStateTape ((next.map Fin.val).getD 0)) 1 :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_Actions_lookup

base.name: Turing.timedCut_serialization_actions

base.name: Turing.timedCut_lookup_parts
base.header: private lemma timedCut_lookup_parts (M : CodeTM) (q : Fin (M.numStates + 1)) (inp work : Option Bool) : ∃ (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1))))) (before : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)))) (after : List Bool), groups.length = q.val ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) ∧ before.length = (universalRecordIndex inp work).val ∧ M.serialize = timedCut_Header M ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ before.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ universalRecordBits (M.tm.tr q inp (fun _ => work)) ++ after :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_ActionBits_decode
base.header: private lemma timedCut_ActionBits_decode {n : ℕ} (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) : universalSign (universalActionBits a 0) (universalActionBits a 1) = a.inputTape ∧ universalWrite (universalActionBits a 2) (universalActionBits a 3) = (a.workTapes 0).1 ∧ universalSign (universalActionBits a 4) (universalActionBits a 5) = (a.workTapes 0).2 ∧ (if universalActionBits a 6 then some (universalActionBits a 7) else none) = a.output :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_select
base.header: private lemma timedCut_select {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))))) (hg : ∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) (before : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1)))) (hb : before.length = index.val) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ before.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.group index) table l.length (universalStateTape groups.length) 1) (2 * groups.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + (before.flatMap universalRecordBits).length + 3) = universalEvalCfg base (.readAction 0 (fun _ => false)) table (l.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + (before.flatMap universalRecordBits).length) (universalStateTape 0) 1 :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_run_join
base.header: private lemma timedCut_run_join {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) {a b c : Cfg k Bool Q x} {s t : ℕ} (hs : tm.runFrom a s = b) (ht : tm.runFrom b t = c) : tm.runFrom a (s + t) = c :=

base.name: Turing.timed_apply_record
base.header: private lemma timed_apply_record (M : CodeTM) (α : List Bool) {x : List Bool} (src : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)) x) (oldp p : ℕ) (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1))) : universalInterpreter.step (universalEvalCfg (universalSimulationCfg M α src oldp) (.applyRecord (universalActionBits a) a.state.isNone) M.serialize p (universalStateTape ((a.state.map Fin.val).getD 0)) 1) = universalSimulationCfg M α (a.apply src) p :=

base.name: Turing.timedCut_live_block
base.header: private lemma timedCut_live_block (M : CodeTM) (α : List Bool) {x : List Bool} (src : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)) x) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ M.serialize.length) (hs : src.state ≠ none) : ∃ (d p' : ℕ) (ready : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl (pairEncode α x)), d ≤ 3 * M.serialize.length + 5 * (M.numStates + 1) + 20 ∧ p' ≤ M.serialize.length ∧ (∃ bits halt, ready.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) ∧ timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalSimulationCfg M α src p) d = ready ∧ universalInterpreter.step ready = universalSimulationCfg M α (M.tm.step src) p' :=

base.name: Turing.timedPrefix_advance
base.header: private lemma timedPrefix_advance (bs α x clock out : List Bool) (q : TimedPrefixControl) (q' : Option TimedPrefixControl) (emit : Option Bool) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x).length) (b : Bool) (hb : (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)[p]? = some b) (htr : ∀ ws, timedPrefixTM.tm.tr q (some b) ws = ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), emit, q'⟩) : timedPrefixTM.tm.step (timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some q) ⟨p + 1, by omega⟩ clock out) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x q' ⟨p + 2, by omega⟩ clock (out ++ emit.toList) :=

base.name: Turing.timedPrefix_write

base.name: Turing.timed_code_get

base.name: Turing.timed_pair_get

base.name: Turing.timed_pair_separator
base.header: private lemma timed_pair_separator (α x : List Bool) : (pairEncode α x)[2 * α.length]? = some false ∧ (pairEncode α x)[2 * α.length + 1]? = some true :=

base.name: Turing.timedPrefix_code

base.name: Turing.timedPrefix_complete
base.header: private lemma timedPrefix_complete (bs α x : List Bool) : timedPrefixTM.tm.runFrom (timedPrefixTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * bs.length + 2 * α.length + 6) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x none ⟨4 * bs.length + 2 * α.length + 7, by rw [timed_input_length]; omega⟩ bs α :=

base.name: Turing.timed_lane_run
base.header: private lemma timed_lane_run {A S R C : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM k A S) (lane : Fin k) (state : R → S) (symbol : C → A) (visit : R → C → R × C) (htr : ∀ s c inp ws, ws lane = some (symbol c) → tm.tr (state s) inp ws = timed_laneAction lane (state (visit s c).1) (some (symbol (visit s c).2)) .pos) (base : Cfg k A S x) (as : List C) (s : R) (z : ℤ) (l r : List (Option A)) : tm.runFrom (timed_laneCfg base lane (some (state s)) z l (as.map (fun c => some (symbol c)) ++ r)) as.length = timed_laneCfg base lane (some (state (FinTM.sweepFold visit s as).1)) (z + as.length) (((FinTM.sweepFold visit s as).2.map (fun c => some (symbol c))).reverse ++ l) r :=

base.name: Turing.timedClock_step
base.header: private lemma timedClock_step {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (q q' : TimedControl) (bs : List Bool) (p : ℤ) (d : SignType) (htr : ∀ inp ws, ws 4 = bufferTape bs p → timedInterpreter.tr q inp ws = timedAdmin (some q') (none, d) (none, 0)) : timedInterpreter.step (timedClockCfg base q bs p) = timedClockCfg base q' bs (p + d) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_back
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_back {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ bs.length → timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedClockCfg base (.clockBack bits halt) bs (j - 1)) (j + 1) = timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt true) bs 0 :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_borrow
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_borrow {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt carry : Bool) (bs : List Bool) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt carry) bs 0) bs.length = timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt (timedBorrow carry bs).1) (timedBorrow carry bs).2 bs.length :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_start
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_start {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) : timedInterpreter.step (timedLift cfg bs) = timedClockCfg (timedLift cfg bs) (.clockBack bits halt) bs (bs.length - 1) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_pass
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_pass {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift cfg bs) (2 * bs.length + 2) = timedClockCfg (timedLift cfg bs) (.borrow bits halt (timedBorrow true bs).1) (timedBorrow true bs).2 bs.length :=

base.name: Turing.timed_execute
base.header: private lemma timed_execute {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) : timedInterpreter.step { timedLift cfg bs with state := some (.execute bits halt) } = timedLift (universalInterpreter.step cfg) bs :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_success
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_success {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) (hv : 0 < timedValue bs) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift cfg bs) (2 * bs.length + 4) = timedLift (universalInterpreter.step cfg) (timedBorrow true bs).2 :=

base.name: Turing.timed_clock_timeout
base.header: private lemma timed_clock_timeout {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) (hv : timedValue bs = 0) : let dst := timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift cfg bs) (2 * bs.length + 3) dst.state = none ∧ dst.output = [false] :=

base.name: Turing.timed_output_step
base.header: private lemma timed_output_step {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (q : TimedControl) (q' : Option TimedControl) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (d : SignType) (emit : Option Bool) (htr : ∀ inp ws, ws 5 = bufferTape cfg.output p → timedInterpreter.tr q inp ws = timedAdmin q' (none, 0) (none, d) emit) : timedInterpreter.step (timedOutputCfg cfg bs (some q) p out) = timedOutputCfg cfg bs q' (p + d) (out ++ emit.toList) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_output_back
base.header: private lemma timed_output_back {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs out : List Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ cfg.output.length → timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedOutputCfg cfg bs (some .emitBack) (j - 1) out) (j + 1) = timedOutputCfg cfg bs (some .flush) 0 (out ++ [true]) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_output_forward
base.header: private lemma timed_output_forward {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (r : List Bool) : ∀ l out, cfg.output = l ++ r → timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedOutputCfg cfg bs (some .flush) l.length out) (r.length + 1) = timedOutputCfg cfg bs none cfg.output.length (out ++ r) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_flush
base.header: private lemma timed_flush {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (hs : cfg.state = none) : let dst := timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift cfg bs) (2 * cfg.output.length + 3) dst.state = none ∧ dst.output = true :: cfg.output :=

base.name: Turing.timedCanon_run

base.name: Turing.timedCanon_complete
base.header: private lemma timedCanon_complete (c : EffectiveMachineCode) (bs α x : List Bool) : let cfg := (timedCanonTM c).tm.runFrom ((timedCanonTM c).tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * bs.length + 3 * α.length + 8 + c.canonizerTime α.length) cfg.state = none ∧ cfg.output = (c.decode α).serialize ∧ cfg.inputPos.val = 4 * bs.length + 2 * α.length + 7 ∧ cfg.workTapes (timedCanonClock c) = bufferTape bs ∧ cfg.workTapePos (timedCanonClock c) = bs.length :=

base.header: private lemma timed_interpret_finishes (M : CodeTM) (α : List Bool) {x : List Bool} (r : ℕ) : ∀ (src : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)) x) (p : ℕ) (bs : List Bool), p ≤ M.serialize.length → timedValue bs = r → ∃ d, d ≤ (3 * M.serialize.length + 5 * (M.numStates + 1) + 20 + 2 * bs.length + 8) * (r + 1) + 2 * src.output.length ∧ let dst := timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift (universalSimulationCfg M α src p) bs) d dst.state = none ∧ dst.output = timedAnswer M src r :=

base.header: private lemma timedCapture_start (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) (x : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).state = none) : ∃ t, t ≤ T + 1 ∧ (timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.runFrom ((timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.initCfg x) t = timedCapturedCfg M clock (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T) :=

base.header: private def timedFrame (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (tapes : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) : Cfg (timedCaptureTM M clock).k Bool (timedCaptureTM M clock).State x :=

base.name: Turing.timedFrame_reads
base.header: private lemma timedFrame_reads (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (tapes : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) : timedSix (fun i => (timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads).workTapeSymbols (Fin.natAdd M.k (i.castAdd 1))) ((timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads).workTapeSymbols (clock.castAdd 5)) ((timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads).workTapeSymbols (Fin.natAdd M.k (4 : Fin 5))) = cfg.workTapeSymbols :=

base.name: Turing.timedFrame_apply
base.header: private lemma timedFrame_apply (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (tapes : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) (a : Action 6 Bool TimedControl) : (timedFrameAction M clock a).apply (timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads) = timedFrame M clock (a.apply cfg) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.timedFrame_step
base.header: private lemma timedFrame_step (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (tapes : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) : (timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.step (timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads) = timedFrame M clock (timedInterpreter.step cfg) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.timedFrame_run
base.header: private lemma timedFrame_run (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (tapes : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : (timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.runFrom (timedFrame M clock cfg tapes heads) t = timedFrame M clock (timedInterpreter.runFrom cfg t) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.timedCaptured_frame
base.header: private lemma timedCaptured_frame (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) {x : List Bool} (src : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (bs : List Bool) (ht : src.workTapes clock = bufferTape bs) (hh : src.workTapePos clock = bs.length) : timedCapturedCfg M clock src = timedFrame M clock (timedLift (timedCut_InterpreterInitial src.inputPos src.output) bs) src.workTapes src.workTapePos :=

base.name: Turing.timed_initialized
base.header: private lemma timed_initialized (c : EffectiveMachineCode) (bs α x : List Bool) : ∃ (t : ℕ) (tapes : Fin (timedCanonTM c).k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin (timedCanonTM c).k → ℤ), t ≤ 4 * bs.length + timedStartupBound c α ∧ (timedUniversalTM c).tm.runFrom ((timedUniversalTM c).tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) t = timedFrame (timedCanonTM c) (timedCanonClock c) (timedLift (universalSimulationCfg (c.decode α) (pairEncode bs α) ((c.decode α).tm.initCfg x) (2 * (Nat.bits (c.decode α).numStates).length + 2 + (c.decode α).tm.q₀.val + 1)) bs) tapes heads :=

base.name: Turing.timed_cost_bound
base.header: private lemma timed_cost_bound (S B t w s d : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ t) (hs : s ≤ 4 * w + S) (hd : d ≤ (B + 2 * w + 8) * (t + 1)) : s + d ≤ (S + B + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2 :=

base.name: Turing.timed_computes
base.header: private lemma timed_computes (c : EffectiveMachineCode) (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (timedUniversalTM c).ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) (timedAnswer (c.decode α) ((c.decode α).tm.initCfg x) t) ((timedStartupBound c α + universalBlockBound c α + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_universal
base.header: theorem timed_universal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (∀ output : List Bool, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) (true :: output) (C * (t + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ ((∀ output : List Bool, ¬(c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false] (C * (t + 1) ^ 2)) :=

base.name: Turing.timed_universal_concrete
base.header: theorem timed_universal_concrete (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (∀ output : List Bool, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) (true :: output) ((3 * α.length + c.canonizerTime α.length + (c.decode α).serialize.length + 2 * (Nat.bits (c.decode α).numStates).length + 2 * (c.decode α).tm.q₀.val + 16 + universalBlockBound c α + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ ((∀ output : List Bool, ¬(c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false] ((3 * α.length + c.canonizerTime α.length + (c.decode α).serialize.length + 2 * (Nat.bits (c.decode α).numStates).length + 2 * (c.decode α).tm.q₀.val + 16 + universalBlockBound c α + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2)) :=

head.name: Turing.universal
head.header: theorem universal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool, (∀ (output : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output (C * (t + 1))) ∧ (∀ output : List Bool, (∃ t, U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output t) → ∃ t, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) :=

head.name: Turing.universal_quadratic
head.header: theorem universal_quadratic (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ (M₀ : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ), M₀.ComputesFunInTime f T → ∃ (α : List Bool) (C : ℕ), ∀ x : List Bool, U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) (f x) (C * (T x.length + 1) ^ 2) :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_Eval_step

head.name: Turing.timedCut_count_run

head.name: Turing.timedCut_initial_skip

head.name: Turing.timedCut_unary_copy
head.header: private lemma timedCut_unary_copy {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (q q' : UniversalControl) (doneMove : SignType) (table : List Bool) (htrue : ∀ inp work, work 0 = some true → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q .pos (some (some true), .pos)) (hfalse : ∀ inp work, work 0 = some false → timedCutInterpreter.tr q inp work = universalAdmin q' doneMove (none, 0)) (n j : ℕ) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate n true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base q table l.length (universalStateTape j) (j + 1)) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base q' table (l.length + n + (doneMove : ℤ)) (universalStateTape (j + n)) (j + n + 1) :=

head.header: private lemma timedCut_Interpreter_first {x : List Bool} (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (table : List Bool) : timedCutInterpreter.step (timedCut_InterpreterInitial p table) = universalEvalCfg (timedCut_InterpreterBase p) (.rewindTable true 0) table (table.length - 1) (universalStateTape 0) 1 :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_Interpreter_initialize
head.header: private lemma timedCut_Interpreter_initialize {x : List Bool} (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (table bits records : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (ht : table = pairEncode bits (List.replicate n true ++ false :: records)) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (timedCut_InterpreterInitial p table) (table.length + 2 * bits.length + 2 * n + 7) = universalEvalCfg (timedCut_InterpreterBase p) .main table (2 * bits.length + 2 + n + 1) (universalStateTape n) 1 :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_fixed
head.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_fixed {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (field : Fin 8) (tp : ℤ), field.val + n = 7 → timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem field) table tp state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.skipUnary dest rem) table (tp + n + 1) state sp :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_unary
head.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_unary {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate n true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipUnary dest rem) table l.length state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0) table (l.length + n + 1) state sp :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_record
head.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_record {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ universalRecordBits a ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp) (universalRecordBits a).length = universalEvalCfg base (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0) table (l.length + (universalRecordBits a).length) state sp :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_records
head.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_records {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (as : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1)))) (l r : List Bool) (rem : Fin 9) (hlen : as.length = rem.val + 1) (ht : table = l ++ as.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp) (as.flatMap universalRecordBits).length = universalEvalCfg base (universalSkipDone dest) table (l.length + (as.flatMap universalRecordBits).length) state sp :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_skip_groups
head.header: private lemma timedCut_skip_groups {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))))) (hg : ∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) (l r : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (ht : table = l ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.group index) table l.length (universalStateWindow j groups.length) (j + 1)) (groups.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.rewindState (some index)) table (l.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length) (universalStateWindow (j + groups.length) 0) (j + groups.length + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_read_fixed
head.header: private lemma timedCut_read_fixed {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.ofFn bits ++ r) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (field : Fin 8) (old : Fin 8 → Bool), field.val + n = 7 → (∀ i : Fin 8, i.val < field.val → old i = bits i) → timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.readAction field old) table (l.length + field.val) state sp) (n + 1) = universalEvalCfg base (.nextState bits) table (l.length + 8) state sp :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_NextCost
head.header: private def timedCut_NextCost {n : ℕ} : Option (Fin (n + 1)) → ℕ

head.name: Turing.timedCut_prepare_next
head.header: private lemma timedCut_prepare_next {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (table : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (next : Option (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ List.replicate (universalNextOnes next) true ++ false :: r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.nextState bits) table l.length (universalStateTape 0) 1) (timedCut_NextCost next) = universalEvalCfg base (.applyRecord bits next.isNone) table (l.length + universalNextOnes next) (universalStateTape ((next.map Fin.val).getD 0)) 1 :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_Actions
head.header: private def timedCut_Actions (M : CodeTM) (q : Fin (M.numStates + 1)) : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1))) :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_Actions_lookup
head.header: private lemma timedCut_Actions_lookup (M : CodeTM) (q : Fin (M.numStates + 1)) (inp work : Option Bool) : (timedCut_Actions M q).length = 9 ∧ (timedCut_Actions M q)[(universalRecordIndex inp work).val]'(by change (universalRecordIndex inp work).val < 9 exact (universalRecordIndex inp work).isLt) = M.tm.tr q inp (fun _ => work) :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_Header
head.header: private def timedCut_Header (M : CodeTM) : List Bool :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_serialization_actions
head.header: private lemma timedCut_serialization_actions (M : CodeTM) : M.serialize = timedCut_Header M ++ ((List.finRange (M.numStates + 1)).map (timedCut_Actions M)).flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_lookup_parts
head.header: private lemma timedCut_lookup_parts (M : CodeTM) (q : Fin (M.numStates + 1)) (inp work : Option Bool) : ∃ (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1))))) (before : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)))) (after : List Bool), groups.length = q.val ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) ∧ before.length = (universalRecordIndex inp work).val ∧ M.serialize = timedCut_Header M ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ before.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ universalRecordBits (M.tm.tr q inp (fun _ => work)) ++ after :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_ActionBits_decode
head.header: private lemma timedCut_ActionBits_decode {n : ℕ} (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) : universalSign (universalActionBits a 0) (universalActionBits a 1) = a.inputTape ∧ universalWrite (universalActionBits a 2) (universalActionBits a 3) = (a.workTapes 0).1 ∧ universalSign (universalActionBits a 4) (universalActionBits a 5) = (a.workTapes 0).2 ∧ (if universalActionBits a 6 then some (universalActionBits a 7) else none) = a.output :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_select
head.header: private lemma timedCut_select {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ} (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (index : Fin 9) (table : List Bool) (groups : List (List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))))) (hg : ∀ g ∈ groups, g.length = 9) (before : List (Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1)))) (hb : before.length = index.val) (l r : List Bool) (ht : table = l ++ groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits) ++ before.flatMap universalRecordBits ++ r) : timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalEvalCfg base (.group index) table l.length (universalStateTape groups.length) 1) (2 * groups.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + (before.flatMap universalRecordBits).length + 3) = universalEvalCfg base (.readAction 0 (fun _ => false)) table (l.length + (groups.flatMap (fun g => g.flatMap universalRecordBits)).length + (before.flatMap universalRecordBits).length) (universalStateTape 0) 1 :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_run_join
head.header: private lemma timedCut_run_join {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) {a b c : Cfg k Bool Q x} {s t : ℕ} (hs : tm.runFrom a s = b) (ht : tm.runFrom b t = c) : tm.runFrom a (s + t) = c :=

head.name: Turing.timed_apply_record
head.header: private lemma timed_apply_record (M : CodeTM) (α : List Bool) {x : List Bool} (src : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)) x) (oldp p : ℕ) (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1))) : universalInterpreter.step (universalEvalCfg (universalSimulationCfg M α src oldp) (.applyRecord (universalActionBits a) a.state.isNone) M.serialize p (universalStateTape ((a.state.map Fin.val).getD 0)) 1) = universalSimulationCfg M α (a.apply src) p :=

head.name: Turing.timedCut_live_block
head.header: private lemma timedCut_live_block (M : CodeTM) (α : List Bool) {x : List Bool} (src : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin (M.numStates + 1)) x) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ M.serialize.length) (hs : src.state ≠ none) : ∃ (d p' : ℕ) (ready : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl (pairEncode α x)), d ≤ 3 * M.serialize.length + 5 * (M.numStates + 1) + 20 ∧ p' ≤ M.serialize.length ∧ (∃ bits halt, ready.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) ∧ timedCutInterpreter.runFrom (universalSimulationCfg M α src p) d = ready ∧ universalInterpreter.step ready = universalSimulationCfg M α (M.tm.step src) p' :=

head.name: Turing.timed_clock_separator

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_advance
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_advance (bs α x clock out : List Bool) (q : TimedPrefixControl) (q' : Option TimedPrefixControl) (emit : Option Bool) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x).length) (b : Bool) (hb : (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)[p]? = some b) (htr : ∀ ws, timedPrefixTM.tm.tr q (some b) ws = ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), emit, q'⟩) : timedPrefixTM.tm.step (timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some q) ⟨p + 1, by omega⟩ clock out) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x q' ⟨p + 2, by omega⟩ clock (out ++ emit.toList) :=

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_write
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_write (bs α x clock : List Bool) (b : Bool) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x).length) : timedPrefixTM.tm.step (timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some (.clockFourth b)) ⟨p + 1, by omega⟩ clock []) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some .clockFirst) ⟨p + 2, by omega⟩ (clock ++ [b]) [] :=

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_clock
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_clock (bs α x : List Bool) : ∀ j, (hj : j ≤ bs.length) → timedPrefixTM.tm.runFrom (timedPrefixTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * j) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some .clockFirst) ⟨4 * j + 1, by rw [timed_input_length]; omega⟩ (bs.take j) [] :=

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_clock_end
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_clock_end (bs α x : List Bool) : timedPrefixTM.tm.runFrom (timedPrefixTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * bs.length + 4) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some .codeFirst) ⟨4 * bs.length + 5, by rw [timed_input_length]; omega⟩ bs [] :=

head.name: Turing.timed_code_get
head.header: private lemma timed_code_get (bs α x : List Bool) (j : ℕ) : (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)[4 * bs.length + 4 + j]? = (pairEncode α x)[j]? :=

head.name: Turing.timed_pair_get
head.header: private lemma timed_pair_get (α x : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < α.length) : (pairEncode α x)[2 * j]? = some α[j] ∧ (pairEncode α x)[2 * j + 1]? = some α[j] :=

head.name: Turing.timed_pair_separator
head.header: private lemma timed_pair_separator (α x : List Bool) : (pairEncode α x)[2 * α.length]? = some false ∧ (pairEncode α x)[2 * α.length + 1]? = some true :=

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_code
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_code (bs α x : List Bool) : ∀ j, (hj : j ≤ α.length) → timedPrefixTM.tm.runFrom (timedPrefixTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * bs.length + 4 + 2 * j) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x (some .codeFirst) ⟨4 * bs.length + 4 + 2 * j + 1, by rw [timed_input_length]; omega⟩ bs (α.take j) :=

head.name: Turing.timedPrefix_complete
head.header: private lemma timedPrefix_complete (bs α x : List Bool) : timedPrefixTM.tm.runFrom (timedPrefixTM.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode bs α) x)) (4 * bs.length + 2 * α.length + 6) = timedPrefixCfg bs α x none ⟨4 * bs.length + 2 * α.length + 7, by rw [timed_input_length]; omega⟩ bs α :=

head.name: Turing.timed_laneCfg_right
head.header: private lemma timed_laneCfg_right {A S : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List A} (base : Cfg k A S x) (lane : Fin k) (q : Option S) (q' : S) (z : ℤ) (l r : List (Option A)) (a b : Option A) : (timed_laneAction lane q' b .pos).apply (timed_laneCfg base lane q z l (a :: r)) = timed_laneCfg base lane (some q') (z + 1) (b :: l) r :=

head.name: Turing.timed_lane_run
head.header: private lemma timed_lane_run {A S R C : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM k A S) (lane : Fin k) (state : R → S) (symbol : C → A) (visit : R → C → R × C) (htr : ∀ s c inp ws, ws lane = some (symbol c) → tm.tr (state s) inp ws = timed_laneAction lane (state (visit s c).1) (some (symbol (visit s c).2)) .pos) (base : Cfg k A S x) (as : List C) (s : R) (z : ℤ) (l r : List (Option A)) : tm.runFrom (timed_laneCfg base lane (some (state s)) z l (as.map (fun c => some (symbol c)) ++ r)) as.length = timed_laneCfg base lane (some (state (FinTM.sweepFold visit s as).1)) (z + as.length) (((FinTM.sweepFold visit s as).2.map (fun c => some (symbol c))).reverse ++ l) r :=

head.name: Turing.timed_borrow_run
head.header: private lemma timed_borrow_run {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt carry : Bool) (bs : List Bool) (z : ℤ) (l r : List (Option Bool)) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timed_laneCfg base 4 (some (.borrow bits halt carry)) z l (bs.map some ++ r)) bs.length = timed_laneCfg base 4 (some (.borrow bits halt (timedBorrow carry bs).1)) (z + bs.length) (((timedBorrow carry bs).2.map some).reverse ++ l) r :=

head.name: Turing.timed_clock_back
head.header: private lemma timed_clock_back {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ bs.length → timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedClockCfg base (.clockBack bits halt) bs (j - 1)) (j + 1) = timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt true) bs 0 :=

head.name: Turing.timed_clock_borrow
head.header: private lemma timed_clock_borrow {x : List Bool} (base : Cfg 6 Bool TimedControl x) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt carry : Bool) (bs : List Bool) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt carry) bs 0) bs.length = timedClockCfg base (.borrow bits halt (timedBorrow carry bs).1) (timedBorrow carry bs).2 bs.length :=

head.name: Turing.timed_clock_start
head.header: private lemma timed_clock_start {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) : timedInterpreter.step (timedLift cfg bs) = timedClockCfg (timedLift cfg bs) (.clockBack bits halt) bs (bs.length - 1) :=

head.name: Turing.timed_clock_pass
head.header: private lemma timed_clock_pass {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (bs : List Bool) (bits : Fin 8 → Bool) (halt : Bool) (hs : cfg.state = some (.applyRecord bits halt)) : timedInterpreter.runFrom (timedLift cfg bs) (2 * bs.length + 2) = timedClockCfg (timedLift cfg bs) (.borrow bits halt (timedBorrow true bs).1) (timedBorrow true bs).2 bs.length :=

head.name: Turing.timed_execute

head.name: Turing.timed_universal
head.header: theorem timed_universal (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (∀ output : List Bool, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) (true :: output) (C * (t + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ ((∀ output : List Bool, ¬(c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false] (C * (t + 1) ^ 2)) :=

head.name: Turing.timed_universal_concrete
head.header: theorem timed_universal_concrete (c : EffectiveMachineCode) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (∀ output : List Bool, (c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) (true :: output) ((3 * α.length + c.canonizerTime α.length + (c.decode α).serialize.length + 2 * (Nat.bits (c.decode α).numStates).length + 2 * (c.decode α).tm.q₀.val + 16 + universalBlockBound c α + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ ((∀ output : List Bool, ¬(c.decode α).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t) → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false] ((3 * α.length + c.canonizerTime α.length + (c.decode α).serialize.length + 2 * (Nat.bits (c.decode α).numStates).length + 2 * (c.decode α).tm.q₀.val + 16 + universalBlockBound c α + 14) * (t + 1) ^ 2)) :=

base.name: Turing.ss_prefix_return_fields
base.header: private theorem ss_prefix_return_fields (F : FinTM Bool) (α w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (hblank : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none)) (hheads : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0)) : let c := F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM F let d := G.tm.runFrom (G.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) d.inputPos.val = 2 * α.length + 3 ∧ d.output = c.output ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapes i = if i.val = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape α else (fun _ => none)) ∧ ∀ i, d.workTapePos i = if i.val = 0 then (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 else 0 :=

base.header: private theorem ss_capturedPrefix_run (F : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime f τ) {n : ℕ} (ι : Fin (FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F)).k ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (α : List Bool) : let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F) let R := ss_captureTM G ι cap ∃ t : ℕ, ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).output = f α ∧ ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none) ∧ ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) ∧ ∀ w : List Bool, R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) = { embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] [] (G.tm.runFrom (G.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t)) with state := some (Sum.inr ()) } ∧ (∀ u < 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ())) ∧ (∀ u ≤ 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) ≤ n * (3 * α.length + 4 + t + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.ss_capturedPrefix_fields
base.header: private theorem ss_capturedPrefix_fields (F : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime f τ) {n : ℕ} (ι : Fin (FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F)).k ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (α : List Bool) : let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F) let R := ss_captureTM G ι cap ∃ t p : ℕ, p ≤ α.length + 1 ∧ ∀ w : List Bool, let d := R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) d.state = some (Sum.inr ()) ∧ d.inputPos.val = 2 * α.length + 3 ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapes (ι i) = if i.val = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape α else (fun _ => none)) ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapePos (ι i) = if i.val = 0 then (p : ℤ) - 1 else 0) ∧ (d.workTapes cap = FinTM.bufferTape (f α) ∧ d.workTapePos cap = (f α).length) ∧ (∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι → j ≠ cap → d.workTapes j = (fun _ => none) ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ (∀ u < 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ())) ∧ (∀ u ≤ 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) ≤ n * (3 * α.length + 4 + t + 1) :=

base.name: Turing.ss_serialized_layout
base.header: private theorem ss_serialized_layout (n : ℕ) (src tbl sm : Fin n) (hst : src ≠ tbl) (hss : src ≠ sm) (hts : tbl ≠ sm) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM n Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ {k m : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (m + 1))), ∃ T ≤ C * ((serializeK M).length + 1), ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg n Bool Q z), d.state = some entry → d.workTapes src = FinTM.bufferTape (serializeK M) → d.workTapePos src = (serializeK M).length → d.workTapes tbl = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos tbl = 0 → d.workTapes sm = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos sm = 0 → (L.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧ (L.runFrom d T).inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ (L.runFrom d T).workTapes = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src (fun _ => none)) tbl (FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr))) sm (fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)) ∧ (L.runFrom d T).workTapePos = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src 0) tbl 0) sm 0 ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, (L.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ ∀ u < T, (L.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done :=

base.name: Turing.exists_selfStartupTMK

base.header: private theorem uk_suffixStartup_run {k K n : ℕ} {P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (α x : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α x)) T = ⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun a => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩) (hcut : ∀ t < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α x)) t).state ≠ some exit) : let ℓ := 2 * α.length + 2 let hlen : ℓ + 1 < (pairEncode α x).length + 2 := by rw [length_pairEncode]; omega (uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).runFrom ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).initCfg (pairEncode α x)) (T + 1 + (2 * ℓ + 3)) = suffixRulerCfg (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done)) M (pairEncode α x) ℓ hlen ∧ (∀ t < T + 1 + (2 * ℓ + 3), ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).runFrom ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).initCfg (pairEncode α x)) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done))) :=

head.header: private theorem ss_prefix_first_halt (F : FinTM Bool) (α : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (hhalt : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t).state = none) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) u).state ≠ none) (w : List Bool) : ((prefixCanonTM F).tm.runFrom ((prefixCanonTM F).tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t)).state = none ∧ ∀ u < 3 * α.length + 4 + t, ((prefixCanonTM F).tm.runFrom ((prefixCanonTM F).tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ none :=

head.name: Turing.ss_cleanCanonizer_first_halt

head.name: Turing.ss_captureInitial

head.header: private theorem ss_capture_run (F : FinTM Bool) {n : ℕ} (ι : Fin F.k ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg x) u).state ≠ none) (hhalt : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none) : (ss_captureTM F ι cap).runFrom ((ss_captureTM F ι cap).initCfg x) t = { embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] [] (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg x) t) with state := some (Sum.inr ()) } ∧ (∀ u < t, ((ss_captureTM F ι cap).runFrom ((ss_captureTM F ι cap).initCfg x) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ())) ∧ (∀ u ≤ t, ((ss_captureTM F ι cap).runFrom ((ss_captureTM F ι cap).initCfg x) u).output = []) :=

head.name: Turing.ss_tapeBlocks_zeroLeft
head.header: private theorem ss_tapeBlocks_zeroLeft {A : Type} (F : FinTM Bool) (left : Fin universalPrefixTM.k → A) (buffer right : A) (i : Fin (FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM F).k) : FinTM.tapeBlocks left buffer (fun _ : Fin F.k => right) (Fin.cast (FinTM.bufferedCompTM_k universalPrefixTM F) i) = if i.val = 0 then buffer else right :=

head.name: Turing.ss_prefix_return_fields
head.header: private theorem ss_prefix_return_fields (F : FinTM Bool) (α w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (hblank : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none)) (hheads : (F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0)) : let c := F.tm.runFrom (F.tm.initCfg α) t let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM F let d := G.tm.runFrom (G.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) d.inputPos.val = 2 * α.length + 3 ∧ d.output = c.output ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapes i = if i.val = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape α else (fun _ => none)) ∧ ∀ i, d.workTapePos i = if i.val = 0 then (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 else 0 :=

head.name: Turing.ss_capturedPrefix_run
head.header: private theorem ss_capturedPrefix_run (F : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime f τ) {n : ℕ} (ι : Fin (FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F)).k ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (α : List Bool) : let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F) let R := ss_captureTM G ι cap ∃ t : ℕ, ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).output = f α ∧ ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none) ∧ ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.runFrom ((ss_cleanCanonizer F).tm.initCfg α) t).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) ∧ ∀ w : List Bool, R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) = { embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] [] (G.tm.runFrom (G.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t)) with state := some (Sum.inr ()) } ∧ (∀ u < 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ())) ∧ (∀ u ≤ 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) ≤ n * (3 * α.length + 4 + t + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.ss_capturedPrefix_fields
head.header: private theorem ss_capturedPrefix_fields (F : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime f τ) {n : ℕ} (ι : Fin (FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F)).k ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (α : List Bool) : let G := FinTM.bufferedCompTM universalPrefixTM (ss_cleanCanonizer F) let R := ss_captureTM G ι cap ∃ t p : ℕ, p ≤ α.length + 1 ∧ ∀ w : List Bool, let d := R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) d.state = some (Sum.inr ()) ∧ d.inputPos.val = 2 * α.length + 3 ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapes (ι i) = if i.val = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape α else (fun _ => none)) ∧ (∀ i, d.workTapePos (ι i) = if i.val = 0 then (p : ℤ) - 1 else 0) ∧ (d.workTapes cap = FinTM.bufferTape (f α) ∧ d.workTapePos cap = (f α).length) ∧ (∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι → j ≠ cap → d.workTapes j = (fun _ => none) ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ (∀ u < 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr ())) ∧ (∀ u ≤ 3 * α.length + 4 + t, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (3 * α.length + 4 + t) ≤ n * (3 * α.length + 4 + t + 1) :=

head.name: Turing.ss_serialized_layout
head.header: private theorem ss_serialized_layout (n : ℕ) (src tbl sm : Fin n) (hst : src ≠ tbl) (hss : src ≠ sm) (hts : tbl ≠ sm) : ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM n Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ), ∀ {k m : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (m + 1))), ∃ T ≤ C * ((serializeK M).length + 1), ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg n Bool Q z), d.state = some entry → d.workTapes src = FinTM.bufferTape (serializeK M) → d.workTapePos src = (serializeK M).length → d.workTapes tbl = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos tbl = 0 → d.workTapes sm = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos sm = 0 → (L.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧ (L.runFrom d T).inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ (L.runFrom d T).workTapes = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src (fun _ => none)) tbl (FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr))) sm (fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)) ∧ (L.runFrom d T).workTapePos = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src 0) tbl 0) sm 0 ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, (L.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ ∀ u < T, (L.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done :=

head.header: private theorem ss_bufferSkip_run {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (α : List Bool) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ α.length + 1) {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg n Bool SeekPhase z) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hbuf : d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape α) (hpos : d.workTapePos i = (p : ℤ) - 1) : let v := if p = 0 then [] else α.drop (p - 1) (skipTM n i).runFrom d (v.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (if p = 0 then 0 else (α.length : ℤ) + 1) } ∧ ∀ u < v.length + 1, ((skipTM n i).runFrom d u).state ≠ some .done :=

head.header: private theorem ss_bufferCleanup_run {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (emptyPos : ℕ) (he : emptyPos ≤ 1) (α : List Bool) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ α.length + 1) (hpe : α = [] → p = emptyPos) {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg n Bool SeekPhase z) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hbuf : d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape α) (hpos : d.workTapePos i = (p : ℤ) - 1) : let v := if p = 0 then [] else α.drop (p - 1) let w := if p = 0 then α else [] let T := v.length + w.length + 3 * α.length + 14 (ss_bufferCleanup n i emptyPos).runFrom ((d.mapState (Sum.inl : SeekPhase → SeekPhase ⊕ (Bool ⊕ SeekPhase))).mapState Sum.inl) T = ⟨some (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done))), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes i (fun _ => none), Function.update d.workTapePos i 0, d.output⟩ ∧ ∀ u < T, ((ss_bufferCleanup n i emptyPos).runFrom ((d.mapState (Sum.inl : SeekPhase → SeekPhase ⊕ (Bool ⊕ SeekPhase))).mapState Sum.inl) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done))) :=

head.name: Turing.exists_selfStartupTMK
head.header: theorem exists_selfStartupTMK (k : ℕ) (E : EffectiveCodeK k) : ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ T B : ℕ, ∀ w : List Bool, R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T = ⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (E.machine α).tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin (E.machine α).q₀) (p - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ ∧ (∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧ (∀ u ≤ T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) u).output = []) ∧ R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) T ≤ B :=

head.name: Turing.exists_selfUniversalK
head.header: theorem exists_selfUniversalK (k : ℕ) (E : EffectiveCodeK k) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ w : List Bool, (∀ (output : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (E.toFinTM α).ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output (C * (t + 1)) ∧ U.tm.spaceUsed (U.tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) (C * (t + 1)) ≤ C * ((E.toFinTM α).tm.spaceUsed ((E.toFinTM α).tm.initCfg (pairEncode α w)) t + 1)) ∧ ∀ output : List Bool, (∃ t', U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t') → ∃ t, (E.toFinTM α).ComputesInTime (pairEncode α w) output t :=

head.name: Turing.uk_suffixStartup_run
head.header: private theorem uk_suffixStartup_run {k K n : ℕ} {P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (α x : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α x)) T = ⟨some exit, 1, fun j => if j.val = k then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) else if j.val = k + 1 then fun a => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2) else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩) (hcut : ∀ t < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg (pairEncode α x)) t).state ≠ some exit) : let ℓ := 2 * α.length + 2 let hlen : ℓ + 1 < (pairEncode α x).length + 2 := by rw [length_pairEncode]; omega (uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).runFrom ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).initCfg (pairEncode α x)) (T + 1 + (2 * ℓ + 3)) = suffixRulerCfg (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done)) M (pairEncode α x) ℓ hlen ∧ (∀ t < T + 1 + (2 * ℓ + 3), ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).runFrom ((uk_suffixStartupTM R exit).initCfg (pairEncode α x)) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr (Sum.inr .done))) :=

head.name: Turing.universalK
head.header: theorem universalK (k : ℕ) (E : EffectiveCodeK k) : ∃ U : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool, (∀ (output : List Bool) (t : ℕ), (E.toFinTM α).ComputesInTime x output t → U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output (C * (t + 1))) ∧ ∀ output : List Bool, (∃ t, U.ComputesInTime (pairEncode α x) output t) → ∃ t, (E.toFinTM α).ComputesInTime x output t :=
